compendium.name: Acrobat
compendium.body:
You are able to perform impressive acrobatic feats. No individual source of opposition related to balance can be used to justify opposition to your actions.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Balancing and Climbing
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.5.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: By My Hand, Set the World in Motion
compendium.body:
Through a combination of speed, dexterity, and uncanny timing, you always have a path forward. In a static environment, this means that you are capable of crazy parkour-like movement to get almost anywhere that could be physically accessed. In a more fluid environment you are impossible to pin down or fence in, as you’ll always find the gap.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Balancing and Climbing
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.95 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Hardcore Parkour
compendium.body:
+2 to overcome actions with Athletics if you are in a chase across rooftops or a similarly precarious environment.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Balancing and Climbing
*Source:* Fate Core, p.98 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Human Spider
compendium.body:
+2 to overcome or create advantage actions with Athletics on any climb.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Balancing and Climbing
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.5.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Mountaineer
compendium.body:
+2 to overcome with Athletics when faced with mountainous terrain.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Balancing and Climbing
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Pole Balance
compendium.body:
+2 to overcome or defend with Athletics when you need to balance and have a pole in hand.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Balancing and Climbing
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Rigging Rat
compendium.body:
+2 to overcome with Athletics when climbing on board a ship.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Balancing and Climbing
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Sea Legs
compendium.body:
Your Athletics skill works unimpeded by conditions like storms, water, or high seas while on board a ship.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Balancing and Climbing
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Acrobatic Dodge
compendium.body:
+2 to overcome with Athletics when another character presents an obstacle to you moving between zones.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Dodging
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: The Drunkard Stumbles
compendium.body:
You stagger and stumble without control, but your enemy always seems to miss you and strike a nearby obstacle, causing damage to themselves. When you dodge a blow with Athletics, your opponent takes one stress, or two stress if you succeed with style.

*Requires:* Falling Drunkard
*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Dodging
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.150 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Dazing Counter
compendium.body:
When you succeed with style on a defend action against an opponent’s Fight roll, you automatically counter with some sort of nerve punch or stunning blow. You get to attach the Dazed situation aspect to your opponent with a free invoke, instead of just a boost.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Dodging
*Source:* Fate Core, p.98 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: The Drunkard’s Stagger
compendium.body:
You sway and stagger on your feet, evading enemy blows seemingly by chance. When you succeed in a defensive Athletics roll using this technique, you gain +1 on your next attack against the opponent who tried to hit you. If you succeed with style, gain +2.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Dodging
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.150 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Evasion
compendium.body:
You have an amazing ability to remain unharmed when caught within the blast radius of an explosion. +2 to defend with Athletics against area attacks.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Dodging
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: The Falling Drunkard
compendium.body:
When an enemy attacks, you lose your balance and fall to the ground, rolling back to your feet quickly, but your enemy now finds himself dangerously overextended. Roll Athletics to dodge. On a success, place a boost on your opponent such as Overextended or Off-Balance that anyone may use against him. On a success with style, place a second boost on your opponent.

*Requires:* Drunkard’s Stagger
*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Dodging
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.150 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Favored Enemy Dodge
compendium.body:
Choose an organisation. You gain +2 to defend with Athletics against members of that group.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Dodging
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Lightning Reflexes
compendium.body:
+2 to defend with Athletics for the first exchange after you become aware of a threat.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Dodging
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Protector
compendium.body:
You are an expert bodyguard. +2 to defend with Athletics whenever you pull someone out of harm's way at great personal risk to yourself.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Dodging
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Reading the Line of Fire
compendium.body:
You can tell where the bullets will go before the trigger is pulled. +2 to Athletics when using it to dodge gunfire.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Dodging
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Redirect Attack
compendium.body:
Once per scene, when you succeed with style on a defence roll with Athletics against Fight, you may force your opponent to attack another of your enemies in the same zone with the same attack roll.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Dodging
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Slippery
compendium.body:
+2 when using Athletics to defend against or overcome knockbacks and pushes.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Dodging
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.5.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: War Mount
compendium.body:
You work together with your rider to defend yourselves. +2 to defend with Athletics while being ridden.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Dodging
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Safe Fall
compendium.body:
You can skip effortlessly down sheer surfaces. Whenever you fail an Athletics roll and fall vertically near a solid surface, reduce the stress you take by 2.

*Requires:* Acrobat
*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Falling
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.5.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Land On Your Feet
compendium.body:
Like a cat, you are able to fall from great heights without excessive harm. When making an Athletics roll to resist falling damage, add +2 to the roll.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Falling
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Fight By Jumping
compendium.body:
It is normally a very bad idea to jump up high while fighting, but you make it work. +2 to Athletics when creating a jump-based advantage in combat, but all aspects created this way disappear at the end of your next turn.

*Requires:* Mighty Leap
*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Jumping
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Long Jump
compendium.body:
+2 to Athletics when jumping significant distances horizontally.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Jumping
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Mighty Leap/Spring-Heeled
compendium.body:
Your leaping ability borders on the superhuman. +2 to overcome with Athletics whenever height is a major factor.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Jumping
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.5.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Out of Reach
compendium.body:
It isn't easy to hit a guy who's five feet above your head. When you create an aspect using Fight By Jumping, you may move into the zone above your current zone as a free action, provided there are no situation aspects restricting that movement.

*Requires:* Fight By Jumping
*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Jumping
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Vault
compendium.body:
+2 to overcome with Athletics when you have a long pole in hand and the obstacle is primarily height-based.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Jumping
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: The Bastard Will Not Escape
compendium.body:
Nobody gets away from you. +2 to overcome with Athletics when chasing someone on foot.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Sprinting
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Fast as a Leopard
compendium.body:
You are incredibly fast on your feet. +2 to create advantage or overcome actions with Athletics used to move multiple zones on the flat.

*Requires:* Sprinter
*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Sprinting
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.5.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Faster than a Leopard
compendium.body:
You are simply, astonishingly fast. When you move multiple zones in a straight line, you get an additional +2 to create advantage or overcome actions with Athletics.

*Requires:* Fast as a Leopard
*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Sprinting
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.5.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Run Away!
compendium.body:
Discretion is the better part of valour, at least for you. On a successful defence with Athletics, you may sacrifice your next action to immediately flee, making an overcome action with Athletics and using your total on the defence roll as your total on the overcome roll.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Sprinting
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Sprinter/Highly Mobile
compendium.body:
You move two zones for free in a conflict without rolling, instead of one, provided there are no situation aspects restricting movement.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Sprinting
*Source:* Fate Core, p.98 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Contortionist
compendium.body:
If you choose to spend an action moving from one zone to an adjacent one, your Athletics skill works unimpeded by conditions such as narrow openings, low ceilings, or other cramped conditions.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Squeezing
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Escapologist
compendium.body:
+2 to overcome actions with Athletics when escaping from bonds.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Squeezing
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.5.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: One With the Water
compendium.body:
+2 to defend or overcome with Athletics while swimming.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Swimming
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Ball Toss
compendium.body:
Throwing a basketball isn't very different from throwing a knife. You may use your Athletics skill in place of Shoot for thrown weapons.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Equestrian
compendium.body:
You can use Athletics instead of Drive whenever you are riding a horse.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.5.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Graceful Silence
compendium.body:
Your natural poise and grace enable you to pass quietly and undetected. You may use your Athletics skill in place of Stealth whenever silence alone would help you move undetected.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Marathon Training
compendium.body:
You know how to conserve your energy when undergoing lengthy athletic activity. You may use Athletics instead of Physique during long-distance running, multi-day climbs, and the like.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.5.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Second-Story Girl
compendium.body:
You can use Athletics in place of Burglary for all overcome actions, provided you don’t have to bypass a lock or interact with other security measures.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Fate Core, p.299 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Whirlwind Step
compendium.body:
When you assume the stance of the whirlwind, roll Athletics against Fair (+2) opposition. If you succeed, you may run on vertical surfaces and leap unlikely distances without making rolls to do so, until your next turn ends. If you succeed with style, you may instead gain these benefits for the rest of the scene.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.35 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Catch
compendium.body:
When defending against an attack with a thrown object, if you succeed with style, you may catch the item that was thrown at you and create a related aspect with a free invoke, instead of just a boost. Details such as your Physique skill and any relevant aspects may be used to determine whether a given object is something you could, practically speaking, catch.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.29.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Childhood Playground
compendium.body:
You are remember the place you grew up in well, and you still find it easy to navigate its obstacles. Name and describe that place. You gain +2 to overcome with Athletics whenever you are in a similar environment.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Flanking Specialist
compendium.body:
Once per scene, when you create the aspect Flanked or similar on an opponent, you gain one additional free invocation of the aspect.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Sportsman
compendium.body:
Sports are your life. Pick a sport. You get a +2 to all Athletics rolls relating to that sport.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikia.com/wiki/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Surefooted
compendium.body:
You suffer no increased difficulty to Athletics due to snowdrifts, loose soil, or shifting sand.

*Skill:* Athletics · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: The Big Heist
compendium.body:
Once per scene, when you case a location you can spend a fate point (and a few minutes of observation) to make a special Burglary roll representing your criminal genius. For each shift you make on this roll you discover or create an aspect on the location, though you may only invoke one of them for free.

*Requires:* Mental Blueprint
*Skill:* Burglary · *Group:* Before the Job
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.6.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Mental Blueprint
compendium.body:
You’re highly skilled at visualizing the whole of a target based on just a part of it. When casing a location, you receive a +2 on Burglary rolls to create an advantage.

*Skill:* Burglary · *Group:* Before the Job
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.6.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Bump and Grab
compendium.body:
Your character is exceptionally skilled at taking advantage of distractions in order to make a quick grab. You may spend a fate point to attempt a simple Burglary action – such as picking a pocket, or palming an object – as a free action.

*Skill:* Burglary · *Group:* On The Job
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.26.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Cool Hand
compendium.body:
A steady hand can be critical when things get hairy. Your hands never shake and never waver. +2 to overcome actions with Burglary whenever you perform fine manual work.

*Skill:* Burglary · *Group:* On The Job
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.26.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Cutpurse
compendium.body:
Once per scene, as a free action, you can attempt to pick the pocket of someone in the same zone as you. Success at no cost on this roll means your victim is not even aware of the theft.

*Skill:* Burglary · *Group:* On The Job
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Hatpin Maestro
compendium.body:
You don’t ever have to spend a fate point to declare that you have the proper tools for lockpicking or disabling a device, even in extreme situations (like being imprisoned and separated from all your stuff). This source of opposition is just off the table.

*Skill:* Burglary · *Group:* On The Job
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.6.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Preferred Target
compendium.body:
Thieves have specialities, just like scientists. Pick a type of location or object (e.g. banks, apartments, handbags). You gain +2 to your Burglary skill when using it against that type of target.

*Skill:* Burglary · *Group:* On The Job
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Security Specialist
compendium.body:
You don’t have to be present to provide active opposition to someone trying to overcome security measures you put in place or worked on. (Normally, a character would roll against passive opposition for that.)

*Skill:* Burglary · *Group:* On The Job
*Source:* Fate Core, p.99 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: The Accounting of Small Things
compendium.body:
Once you have successfully stolen something small enough to fit in a pocket, it is gone until you choose to reveal it again. No amount of searching—or even stripping—will reveal the purloined item. You may only have one such item at a time hidden in this fashion.

*Skill:* Burglary · *Group:* After the Job
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.96 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Always a Way Out
compendium.body:
+2 on Burglary rolls made to create an advantage whenever you’re trying to escape from a location.

*Skill:* Burglary · *Group:* After the Job
*Source:* Fate Core, p.99 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Criminal Mind
compendium.body:
+2 on Burglary rolls made to create an advantage when investigating another criminal's work which closely matches a crime you have committed before.

*Skill:* Burglary · *Group:* After the Job
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.6.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Without a Trace
compendium.body:
You don’t have to be present to provide active opposition to someone trying to analyse physical evidence that you were present during a crime. (Normally, a character would roll against passive opposition for that.)

*Skill:* Burglary · *Group:* After the Job
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.27.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Legerdemain
compendium.body:
+2 to Burglary rolls made to perform magic tricks.

*Skill:* Burglary · *Group:* Magic
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.26.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Master of Illusion
compendium.body:
The time it takes for you to prepare a large illusion is reduced by two shifts.

*Requires:* Stage Magic
*Skill:* Burglary · *Group:* Magic
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.26.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Stage Magic
compendium.body:
You can perform misdirection on a large scale, under appropriately controlled circumstances. Provided you are acting within an arena you control (such as a stage, or an area you have had adequate time to prepare), there are simply no size limitations (within reason) for your Burglary targets.

*Requires:* Legerdemain
*Skill:* Burglary · *Group:* Magic
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.26.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Disable Device
compendium.body:
If you can take apart a lock, you can take apart a clock. You may use Burglary instead of Crafts to disassemble anything mechanical.

*Skill:* Burglary · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Five-Fingered Discount
compendium.body:
Why buy what you can steal? You may use your Burglary skill instead of your Resources skill to “buy” things. Everything obtained this way has the aspect Stolen Property with one free invocation against you. The difficulty of an attempt to obtain something with Burglary may or may not be the same as the difficulty of an attempt to buy that same thing with Resources, at the GM's discretion. The time required may also vary.

*Skill:* Burglary · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Talk the Talk
compendium.body:
You can use Burglary in place of Contacts whenever you’re dealing specifically with other thieves and burglars.

*Skill:* Burglary · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Fate Core, p.99 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Trespass Tempo
compendium.body:
Whenever you’re running a heist, you operate on a very precise internal clock. You may use Burglary instead of Notice to determine turn order as long as everything is going to plan.

*Requires:* Tripwire Sensibilities
*Skill:* Burglary · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.6.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Tripwire Sensibilities
compendium.body:
You’ve run into enough traps that you’ve developed an instinct for avoiding them. You may roll Burglary instead of Investigate or Notice in order to spot or defend against a trap.

*Skill:* Burglary · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.6.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: You’re Never Safe
compendium.body:
You can use Burglary to make mental attacks and create advantages against a target, by staging a heist in such a way as to shatter their confidence in their security.

*Skill:* Burglary · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Fate Core, p.89 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Burglar's Signature
compendium.body:
Some element of your character makes you an expert thief. Pick one of your aspects. Once per scene, you may invoke that aspect on a Burglary roll for free.

*Skill:* Burglary · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: I, Lupin!
compendium.body:
Somehow, you can always pull of a stroke of larcenous brilliance when it really counts. Once per scene, when you succeed on a Burglary roll, you may choose to succeed with style instead.

*Skill:* Burglary · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Center of the Web
compendium.body:
Whether or not you lead it, you are like the spider at the center of a web regarding any organization of which you are a part. Information about the organization flows your way naturally, taking one time increment less to reach your attentive ears than it would normally, and so long as you are able to make any sort of contact with the outside world, you are quickly able to find out information about your organization’s dealings. You also gain +1 to Contacts rolls related to your organization.

*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* Active Networks
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.18.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Discreet Enquiries
compendium.body:
You are unusually subtle when it comes to gathering information. Whenever you seek information and an opponent rolls Contacts to be alerted to this activity, you may roll active opposition against them.

*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* Active Networks
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: The Strength of One Becomes the Strength of Many
compendium.body:
Once you begin a contacting effort, it becomes self-sustaining, as people you talk to talk to other people, who talk to others in turn. In effect, you will always get an answer; it is only a matter of time.

*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* Active Networks
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.99 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Ubiquity
compendium.body:
First, this stunt steps up the intensity of your Center of the Web stunt – information flows your way a total of two time increments faster. Second, this stunt removes the restriction “so long as you are able to make any sort of contact with the outside world.” Your ties into the organization are so thoroughly widespread that the outside world makes every reasonable effort to stay in contact with you. For a fate point, your organization can even make some fairly unreasonable efforts to stay in contact.

*Requires:* Center of the Web
*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* Active Networks
*Source:* Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.18.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: The Bonds of Man Stretch to the Horizon
compendium.body:
There is no place where you do not know someone, including places you have never been before. You will find a friend wherever you go.

*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* Cold Opens
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.99 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Bounty Board
compendium.body:
Whenever you enter a settlement, you can look for work. After an hour or so, you find a job that either pays well but is dangerous or is not too dangerous but doesn’t pay that well. If you spend a fate point, it both pays well and is not too dangerous.

*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* Cold Opens
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.41 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Criminal Underbelly
compendium.body:
Whenever you enter a settlement for the first time, you can spend a fate point to declare that the local criminals know you. Choose one of the following: they have a lead on a promising job, they’ll give you and your companions free room and board for a few weeks, or they’ll help you with something right now but you might owe them afterward.

*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* Cold Opens
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.42 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: A Friend in Every Port
compendium.body:
Whenever you enter a settlement, you may declare you’ve visited it before and roll Contacts against Fair (+2) opposition. If you succeed, you have a friend there who owes you one favor—nothing costly or life threatening. If you succeed with style, your friend will do any one thing for you that is within his power.

*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* Cold Opens
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.35 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Friends Everywhere
compendium.body:
Your network of contacts extends around the world. You never suffer any increased difficulty on Contacts rolls from being in an unfamiliar area.

*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* Cold Opens
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Absolute Authority
compendium.body:
You are good at being in charge. +2 to Contacts as long as you are in a position of direct authority over those you intend to contact.

*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* Specific Groups or Subjects
*Source:* Evil Hat Productions Wiki · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Chain of Command
compendium.body:
You are a soldier, and other soldiers answer to you. Add two to your Contacts skill when using it to deal with soldiers from your organisation.

*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* Specific Groups or Subjects
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Common Interests/On the Watch
compendium.body:
You know people who know things about the things that you want to know about. Pick a broad subject (e.g. the royal court, baseball, university politics). Add +2 to Contacts when using it to enquire about that subject.

*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* Specific Groups or Subjects
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Eye for Talent
compendium.body:
+2 to Contacts when seeking promising young people.

*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* Specific Groups or Subjects
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: I'm Looking for Mr
compendium.body:
Brown. You are extremely good at tracking people down. +2 to Contacts whenever you are seeking a specific person whose name you know.

*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* Specific Groups or Subjects
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Member
compendium.body:
Pick a specific organisation. You belong to that organisation. Whenever you want to get in touch with its other members, gain +2 to Contacts.

*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* Specific Groups or Subjects
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Noble Born
compendium.body:
+2 to Contacts when seeking another member of the aristocracy.

*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* Specific Groups or Subjects
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Renowned Courtesan
compendium.body:
+2 to Contacts when seeking lonely people who would be sexually attracted to you.

*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* Specific Groups or Subjects
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Salesman's Network
compendium.body:
All good salesmen build up a network of satisfied customers over time. Pick a type of product. Add two to your Contacts skill when looking for or dealing with makers, sellers, or notable consumers of that type of product.

*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* Specific Groups or Subjects
*Source:* http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Too Cool for School
compendium.body:
All the kids wanna be just like you. +2 to Contacts when dealing with young adults of middle school or high school age.

*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* Specific Groups or Subjects
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Walk the Walk
compendium.body:
Your travels have taken you to every corner of the globe. +2 to Contacts rolls when dealing with foreign lands or cultures.

*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* Specific Groups or Subjects
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.7.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Big Man
compendium.body:
Pick a specific field of endeavour, such as crime, business, politics, espionage, or the occult. Within this field, you are considered a person of great importance. You may roll Contacts instead of Resources for anything which might fall under the auspices of members of that field.

*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.7.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Big Name
compendium.body:
You’re so well known that an awareness of your name has crossed over into other areas as well. The first time you deal with someone who’s heard of you (spending a fate point can assure that they have), and you’re using your name, you get a +2 bonus to a Provoke or Rapport roll.

*Requires:* Big Man
*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.7.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Big Reputation
compendium.body:
Your reputation has reached great proportions, and people are willing to believe all sorts of things about you. For a fate point, you may use your Contacts skill instead of Deceive, Rapport, Provoke, or Will, provided those you are dealing with are aware of your reputation (a second fate point will nearly always assure that they are). This stunt combines with the bonus from Big Name, getting the character a +2 to Contacts when using it instead of Provoke or Rapport.

*Requires:* Big Name
*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.7.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Ear to the Ground
compendium.body:
Whenever someone initiates a conflict against you in an area where you’ve built a network of contacts, you use Contacts instead of Notice to determine turn order, because you got tipped off in time.

*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Fate Core, p.101 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Insider
compendium.body:
You are able to navigate bureaucracies easily, not because you understand them, but because you know people embedded in the bureaucracy who can provide shortcuts. You may roll Contacts instead of Resources when dealing with any sort of bureaucratic entanglement.

*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.7.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: My Buddy Has One of Those
compendium.body:
Your friends are very willing to let you borrow whatever you need. You may use your Contacts skill instead of your Resources skill to “buy” things. Everything obtained this way has the aspect Not Actually Mine with one free invocation against you. The difficulty of an attempt to obtain something with Contacts may or may not be the same as the difficulty of an attempt to buy that same thing with Resources, at the GM's discretion. The time required may also vary.

*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Talk the Talk
compendium.body:
Whenever dealing with members of your chosen field, you may roll Contacts instead of Rapport.

*Requires:* Big Man
*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.7.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: The Weight of Reputation
compendium.body:
You can use Contacts instead of Provoke to create advantages based on the fear generated by the sinister reputation you’ve cultivated for yourself and all the shady associates you have. You should have an appropriate aspect to pair with this stunt.

*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Fate Core, p.101 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: I Know a Guy Who Knows a Guy
compendium.body:
Sometimes it’s not who you know, but who the people you know, know. Many of your contacts are, themselves, very well connected. +2 to Contacts when you attempt to corroborate information you’ve gotten from another of your contacts.

*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.7.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Rumormonger
compendium.body:
+2 to create an advantage when you plant vicious rumors about someone else.

*Skill:* Contacts · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate Core, p.101 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Always Making Useful Things
compendium.body:
You don’t ever have to spend a fate point to declare that you have the proper tools for a particular job using Crafts, even in extreme situations (like being imprisoned and separated from all your stuff). This source of opposition is just off the table.

*Skill:* Crafts · *Group:* Tools
*Source:* Fate Core, p.103 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Big Pocking Wrench
compendium.body:
You can do a lot as long as you have your trusty giant wrench on hand. +2 to Crafts when using it to fix or break something with a large wrench, provided the wrench is actually useful for what you are using it for.

*Skill:* Crafts · *Group:* Tools
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Demolitions
compendium.body:
You are an expert with explosives. +2 to attack rolls made with Crafts against a target structure whenever you have time to prepare and place charges at its exact weak points.

*Skill:* Crafts · *Group:* Tools
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.12.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: The Tools Are Lesser than the Hand
compendium.body:
You can produce master-craftsman-level work with the crudest of tools. With a proper workshop, you can create impossibly amazing devices in the finest da Vinci style.

*Skill:* Crafts · *Group:* Tools
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.99 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Workshop of Choice
compendium.body:
Pick a specific workshop or machine shop. You know exactly how this place is arranged and how it operates, and gain +2 on Crafts whenever you perform work within it.

*Skill:* Crafts · *Group:* Tools
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikia.com/wiki/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Architect of Death
compendium.body:
+2 to Crafts rolls when designing, repairing or upgrading weaponry.

*Skill:* Crafts · *Group:* Targets
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.12.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Favored Material
compendium.body:
Choose a type of solid material (e.g. wood, steel, bone). +2 to Crafts when you work predominantly with that substance.

*Skill:* Crafts · *Group:* Targets
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: From Another Time
compendium.body:
You are intimately familiar with the technology of a time other than the present. Choose a time period other than the present day. Add two to your Crafts skill when working with objects or materials from that time period.

*Skill:* Crafts · *Group:* Targets
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Grease Monkey
compendium.body:
If it has an engine and wings, propellers, or wheels, you “get” it, intuitively and completely. +2 to Crafts when dealing with vehicles.

*Skill:* Crafts · *Group:* Targets
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.12.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Master Bowyer
compendium.body:
+2 to Crafts when crafting or repairing bows.

*Skill:* Crafts · *Group:* Targets
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Shipwright
compendium.body:
+2 to Crafts when building or repairing boats or ships.

*Skill:* Crafts · *Group:* Targets
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Stonemason
compendium.body:
+2 to create advantage with Crafts when assessing or working with stone.

*Skill:* Crafts · *Group:* Targets
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Surgical Strikes
compendium.body:
When using Crafts in a conflict involving machinery, you can filter out unwanted targets from whole-zone attacks without having to divide up your shifts (normally, you’d need to divide your roll between your targets).

*Skill:* Crafts · *Group:* Targets
*Source:* Fate Core, p.103 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Taxidermist
compendium.body:
+2 to Crafts when preserving, stuffing, or posing dead animals.

*Skill:* Crafts · *Group:* Targets
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Better than New!
compendium.body:
Whenever you succeed with style on an overcome action to repair a piece of machinery, you can immediately give it a new situation aspect (with a free invoke) reflecting the improvements you’ve made, instead of just a boost.

*Skill:* Crafts · *Group:* Techniques
*Source:* Fate Core, p.103 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Bricoleur
compendium.body:
You are skilled at improvising when making or repairing something. +2 to Crafts when you creatively incorporate reused materials into your machine.

*Skill:* Crafts · *Group:* Techniques
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Eye For Flaws
compendium.body:
+2 to create advantage with Crafts when you examine an object or machine for physical weaknesses.

*Skill:* Crafts · *Group:* Techniques
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Hogtie
compendium.body:
When you use Crafts to create a Hogtied (or similar) advantage on someone, you can always actively oppose any overcome rolls to escape the hogtie (also using Crafts), even if you’re not there. (Normally, if you weren’t there, the escaping character would roll against passive opposition, making it a lot easier to escape.)

*Skill:* Crafts · *Group:* Techniques
*Source:* Fate Core, p.91 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Master Bricoleur
compendium.body:
When you succeed on a roll to which the Bricoleur stunt applies, your success takes two time steps less than normal.

*Requires:* Skilled Bricoleur
*Skill:* Crafts · *Group:* Techniques
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Mister Fix-It
compendium.body:
You are talented at getting things repaired under time-critical circumstances. The time it takes for you to get something fixed is reduced by two shifts.

*Skill:* Crafts · *Group:* Techniques
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.12.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Scavenger
compendium.body:
There is an art to making things quickly out of cannibalized parts. You find it easy, because the people who made the thing you took apart did most of the work. +2 to create advantages with Crafts whenever you disassemble machinery for later re-use.

*Skill:* Crafts · *Group:* Techniques
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Skilled Bricoleur
compendium.body:
Necessity is the mother of invention. +2 to Crafts when you have nothing to build with except inappropriate materials.

*Requires:* Bricoleur
*Skill:* Crafts · *Group:* Techniques
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Thump of Restoration/Percussive Maintenance
compendium.body:
Sometimes a bunch of repairs can get short-handed with a good swift thump. To activate this ability, spend a fate point and roll Crafts (vs. a target of Mediocre). If your roll succeeds, the device or contraption starts working and continues working for a number of exchanges equal to the shifts gained on the Crafts roll. Once the time is up, the device stops working again, and any efforts to repair it are at a one step higher difficulty (since, after all, you hit the thing). If you wish to thump again, you may do so for another fate point, but the difficulty for the Crafts roll increases by one on each subsequent attempt.

*Requires:* Mister Fix-It
*Skill:* Crafts · *Group:* Techniques
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.12.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Locksmith
compendium.body:
If you can take apart a clock, you can take apart a lock. You may roll Crafts instead of Burglary when lockpicking.

*Skill:* Crafts · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Personalized Weaponry Engineering
compendium.body:
Clever engineering can compensate for a lack of combat skill. Pick a broad category of weapon (e.g. swords, polearms, crossbows). When you wield a weapon of this sort that you have created yourself, you may attack with Crafts instead of Fight (for melee weapons) or Shoot (for ranged weapons). Such weapons will often include odd devices and unusual features that make their use very different from that of a normal weapon.

*Skill:* Crafts · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Brilliant Disguise
compendium.body:
Once per scene, when you succeed on a Deceive roll to create a disguise, you succeed with style instead.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Disguises and Covers
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Cover
compendium.body:
You have a cover identity you can assume. Describe your cover identity, choose a high concept and a trouble aspect for your cover identity, and choose an apex skill for your cover identity. You can assume that identity with enough preparation and the expenditure of a fate point. While you’re in that identity, its high concept and trouble replace yours and you can use Deceive in place of its apex skill. You lose these benefits as soon as your cover is blown, and you may have to spend some time creating a new cover identity.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Disguises and Covers
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.42 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Double Life
compendium.body:
If you are in disguise at the start of a scene, you gain the aspect Definitely Not <your real name> with one free invocation. If you are not in disguise at the start of a scene, you gain the aspect Definitely Not <your secret identity> with one free invocation. These aspects go away at the end of each scene.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Disguises and Covers
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Infiltrator
compendium.body:
While you are Disguised as Someone Insignificant (see Master of Disguise) you may make a single Investigate roll against a target of Mediocre. Each shift gained can be used to do one of two things: gain a useful (but general) piece of information about the area or group being infiltrated, or leave a clue, hint or message for another character without revealing yourself.

*Requires:* Master of Disguise
*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Disguises and Covers
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.8.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Instant Cover
compendium.body:
You can whip up a cover story like no one’s business, even if you haven’t made an effort to establish it beforehand. Any time you overcome an obstacle in public using Deceive, automatically add a situation aspect representing your cover story, and stick a free invocation on it.

*Requires:* Fast Talk
*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Disguises and Covers
*Source:* Fate Core, p.95 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Master of Disguise
compendium.body:
You can convincingly pass yourself off as nearly anyone with a little time and preparation. To use this ability, you pay a fate point to disappear from the scene, gaining the Disguised as Someone Insignificant aspect on yourself. At any subsequent point during play, you choose any nameless NPC in a scene and reveal that that character is actually you in disguise! You may remain in this state for as long as you choose, but if anyone is tipped off that you might be nearby, they may spend a fate point and roll Investigate against your Deceive to overcome the aspect. If the investigator wins, he gets to decide which filler character is actually you in disguise (“Wait a minute – you’re the Emerald Emancipator!”).

*Requires:* Mimicry and Quick Disguise
*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Disguises and Covers
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.8.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Mimicry
compendium.body:
You may create advantages with Deceive related to imitating the mannerisms and voice of anyone you’ve had a chance to study. Studying someone usually requires only an investment of time, and not a roll of the dice – at least half an hour of constant exposure. This timeframe can be reduced, but will require an Empathy, Investigate, or Deceive roll against a target of Mediocre - any shifts you get on the roll reduce the time required.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Disguises and Covers
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.8.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: One Person, Many Faces
compendium.body:
Whenever you meet someone new, you can spend a fate point to declare that you’ve met that person before, but under a different name and identity. Create a situation aspect to represent your cover story, and you can use Deceive in place of Rapport whenever interacting with that person.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Disguises and Covers
*Source:* Fate Core, p.104 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Perfect Reflection
compendium.body:
+2 to create advantage or defend with Deceive when you are disguised as someone you know well and that disguise is in question.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Disguises and Covers
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Quick Disguise
compendium.body:
You’re able to put together a convincing disguise in a heartbeat, using items from your surroundings. You can roll Deceive to create a disguise without any time to prepare, in nearly any situation.

*Requires:* Fast Talk
*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Disguises and Covers
*Source:* Fate Core, p.95 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Trick the Toffs
compendium.body:
+2 to Deceive when you disguise yourself as someone from the upper classes.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Disguises and Covers
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Versatile Disguises
compendium.body:
You suffer no increased difficulty on Deceive rolls when disguising yourself as a person of different gender, height, skin tone, or age.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Disguises and Covers
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Dead For Sure
compendium.body:
While you are Feigning Death, no-one will even check to see if you really are dead until all of your allies have conceded or been taken out.

*Requires:* Play Dead
*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Feinting and Feigning
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Fast Feint
compendium.body:
Once per scene, you may roll Deceive to perform a feint as a free action.

*Requires:* Feint
*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Feinting and Feigning
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Feint
compendium.body:
When it looks like you're going to go right, you go left. And vice versa. +2 to create advantages with Deceive that relate to confusion and misdirection in physical combat.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Feinting and Feigning
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Feint En Masse
compendium.body:
You may feint against every opponent in your zone in one action, dividing your shifts between them.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Feinting and Feigning
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Impenetrable Bluff
compendium.body:
You can bluff like a poker pro. Maybe you are a poker pro. +2 to create advantages or defend with Deceive when using it to trick people into believing that you are more capable or better positioned than you actually are.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Feinting and Feigning
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Not a Threat
compendium.body:
Choose Deceive or Stealth when you take this stunt. When you create an advantage with that skill to make yourself as non-threatening or unobtrusive as possible, enemies will find other targets for as long as that aspect exists. As soon as you successfully attack someone, the aspect goes away.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Feinting and Feigning
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.42 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Play Dead
compendium.body:
When you place an aspect like Feigning Death on yourself, no-one can attack you while the aspect remains in play.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Feinting and Feigning
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Superior Feint
compendium.body:
Whenever you place an aspect on an opponent using the Feint stunt, you may defend against their melee attacks with Deceive until that aspect goes away.

*Requires:* Feint
*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Feinting and Feigning
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Worthy Cringe
compendium.body:
+2 to create advantage with Deceive when you try to appear unthreatening during a physical combat.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Feinting and Feigning
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Crooked Dealer in Antiquities
compendium.body:
+2 to create advantages with Deceive based on the (false) monetary value of archaeological finds.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* A Fool and His Money
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Crooked Salesman
compendium.body:
You are skilled at subtly misrepresenting your goods or services to customers. +2 to Deceive when using it to sell something.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* A Fool and His Money
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikia.com/wiki/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Faustian Pact
compendium.body:
Your job is to trick people into signing unfair contracts. When you have a copy of such a contract to hand, you gain +2 on Deceive rolls to fool people into thinking it is fair.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* A Fool and His Money
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Grifter/Professional Panhandler
compendium.body:
You profit from your lies, literally. +2 to Deceive when using it to fool someone into giving you money.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* A Fool and His Money
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikia.com/wiki/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: The Devil's Own Luck
compendium.body:
On games of pure chance, like roulette, where a character could not normally roll a skill to affect the outcome, you may use your Deceive skill at its full value.

*Requires:* one other stunt relating to gambling
*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Gambling
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.14.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Double or Nothing
compendium.body:
Once per scene, when involved in a game of chance, you can declare "Double or Nothing!" This is a call for both sides to reroll (and as such doesn’t involve fate points). If you win the next roll, the initial exchange is treated as a scratch (no loss to any participants), but if you lose (by whatever amount) the number of shifts you lose by is doubled. Regardless of the result, such a move often elevates the stakes of a game. This can turn a regular stakes game into a high stakes one, and a high stakes game into a matter of life and death.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Gambling
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.14.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Know When to Fold 'Em
compendium.body:
Whenever gambling with NPCs, you may ask that the GM roll the NPC’s Deceit in advance. Whenever the GM does this, the roll is automatically considered to be secret – she doesn’t have to show it to anyone. The twist is that the GM must indicate to you whether the NPC’s roll is above or below your Deceive skill – just not by how much. Given this knowledge, you may then choose whether you participates, or excuses yourself, from the gambling contest. If you do participate, the GM reveals the value of the roll, and may still spend fate points on behalf of her NPC as usual once the contest starts in earnest.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Gambling
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.14.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Winnings
compendium.body:
You win at the gambling tables more than you lose, and are often flush with cash. Once per session, you may use Deceive instead of Resources to represent these winnings, so long as you haven’t recently experienced a loss. You must provide a quick one-sentence explanation of what the resource is and how you won it, when using this stunt.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Gambling
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.14.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Corroboration of Coincidence
compendium.body:
Fate favors your lies with minor coincidences and circumstantial evidence that seem to lend them credence. You may apply a boost to the scene before you roll Deceive, so long as you can describe how it helps you look more honest. If successful, the boost turns into an aspect on the scene.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Scot-Free
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.96 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Hey, What’s That?
compendium.body:
Gain a +2 bonus whenever you’re using Deceive to momentarily distract someone, as long as part of the distraction involves saying something.

*Requires:* Fast Talk
*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Scot-Free
*Source:* Fate Core, p.95 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Houdini
compendium.body:
You could be found by the police standing next to a burned-down church with a handful of matches and a can of gasoline and still get away scot-free. +2 to Deceive when using it to defend against attempts to discern or prove your involvement in a crime.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Scot-Free
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Low Profile
compendium.body:
You always provide active opposition to attempts to locate you with Investigate.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Scot-Free
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: The Appearance of Wealth
compendium.body:
You seem like a wealthy and powerful person, regardless of the reality. You may use Deceive in place of Resources as long as no actual money or goods need to change hands.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Con Man
compendium.body:
You are a bona fide confidence man, and that lets you get a read on people, easy. You may use Deceive instead of Empathy to read a person’s emotional state and get a general sense of who they are, but the type of aspects that may be assessed or created are limited to things like their trouble or other negatively skewed/easily exploitable aspects.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.8.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: "Honest" Lawyer
compendium.body:
Okay, maybe they don’t exist. But most people would say that you are one, anyway. You may use Deceit instead of Lore whenever knowledge of the law or legal matters are involved.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Illusion of Grandeur
compendium.body:
Making a good first impression is all about misrepresenting yourself. Whenever you meet a new person, you may use Deceit instead of Rapport to influence them. This option vanishes as soon as you fail one of the Deceit rolls.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: It's Just Creative Lying
compendium.body:
Really, acting is just an advanced form of lying. You may use your Deceive skill instead of Rapport when acting.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Mind Games
compendium.body:
You can use Deceive in place of Provoke to make mental attacks, as long as you can make up a clever lie as part of the attack.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Fate Core, p.104 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Players' Club
compendium.body:
You’ve played in so many games, and in so many places, that it’s rare that you can’t find someone who knows you. You may use your Deceit skill instead of Contacts whenever making a Contacts roll – though doing so invariably colors the results with the nature of gambling.

*Requires:* one other stunt relating to gambling
*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.14.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Shield of Lies
compendium.body:
Your lies run so deep that you almost believe them yourself. You may use Deceive to defend against mental attacks whenever an opponent focuses on a truth you consistently deny.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Takes One to Know One
compendium.body:
As an accomplished liar, you’re especially able to figure out when someone else is lying as well. You may use Deceive instead of Empathy to defend against Deceive actions.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.8.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Bait of Words
compendium.body:
Gain an additional +2 to Deceive whenever you invoke an advantage you personally created by speaking to the target and rolling Rapport.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Fast Talk
compendium.body:
You get a +2 to overcome obstacles with Deceive, provided you don’t have to talk to the person you’re trying to deceive for more than a few sentences before blowing past them.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate Core, p.95 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Founded Upon Lies
compendium.body:
You are very good at turning innocuous lies into devastating ones. Once per scene, when you succeed on a Deceit roll, you may succeed with style instead.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: The Honest Lie
compendium.body:
The best lies are the ones that contain a healthy dose of truth. You gain a +2 to Deceive whenever you incorporate a hefty portion of the truth into a lie. The truth must be relevant, not unimportant, and significant, not trivial – it must be on par with (or bigger than) the lie, or at least in the ballpark.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.8.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Lies upon Lies
compendium.body:
+2 to create a Deceive advantage against someone who has believed one of your lies already during this session.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate Core, p.104 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Master Manipulator
compendium.body:
You can treat other people like chess pieces and make it work. +2 to attack and create advantages with Deceive whenever you try to trick your target into following a preset plan of yours.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: One Big Lie
compendium.body:
Pick one specific statement that isn't true. You gain +2 to Deceive when using it to convince someone that that statement is true.

*Skill:* Deceive · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: City Driver
compendium.body:
You've spent most of your life driving up and down the same streets. Pick a city. Whenever you are in that city, you never suffer increased difficulty on Drive rolls due to traffic.

*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* On the Road
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Defensive Driving
compendium.body:
You’re good at keeping your car in one piece. +2 to overcome with Drive during a chase.

*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* On the Road
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.9.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Barnstormer
compendium.body:
You can squeeze your plane through places where it has no business fitting. You never need to spend a fate point to declare details relating to your plane having enough clearance space to fly or land. What’s more, if you do spend a fate point, you can fit the plane in places you absolutely should not be able to.

*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* In the Sky
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.21.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Death from Above
compendium.body:
While in flight, if you are able to make an attack on another flying target from an elevated position, you do two additional points of stress on a successful hit. However, this action takes you out of your position of advantage.

*Requires:* Flying Ace
*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* In the Sky
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.21.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Fly By Night
compendium.body:
Whether in dead of night or during a storm, your piloting skills remain true. You never face increased difficulties due to environmental factors (darkness, weather) when flying. This does not protect your plane from taking damage from the environment – but your skill remains unreduced.

*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* In the Sky
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.21.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Walk Away From It
compendium.body:
You have a great instinct for crash-landing planes, and are able to walk away from even the most catastrophic-seeming landings. While you are piloting a plane into its crash landing, coincidence conspires to keep you and your passengers alive, and you pass from the view of the other combatants. You may re-enter play in any subsequent scene in as dramatic a fashion as you see fit, explaining to everyone how you survived. You return with all of your physical stress cleared and a single additional consequence incurred to reflect the dangers you defied.

*Requires:* at least two other Drive stunts
*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* In the Sky
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.21.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Bareback Rider
compendium.body:
You suffer no increasing difficulty to Drive rolls while riding an animal due to a lack of saddle, reins, or other tack.

*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* On Horseback
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Breaking It In
compendium.body:
You’re skilled at breaking in new mounts. You receive +2 on all Drive rolls during such an effort. (We suggest you run breaking in a mount as a conflict between rider and steed. The rider should make mental attacks using Drive vs. Will on the animal while the animal is making Athletics or Physique vs. Drive physical attacks on the rider. When one party is finally taken out, takes a consequence, or concedes, either the animal is broken or the rider is thrown.)

*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* On Horseback
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.28.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Hell Bent for Leather
compendium.body:
You know how to get the best speed out of your mount. +2 to Drive whenever you're on horseback and riding at top speed. You must be an active participant in driving your mount forward in order to receive this bonus. The benefit doesn’t apply if you’re, say, in the saddle, but unconscious.

*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* On Horseback
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.28.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Mounted Trample
compendium.body:
Once per scene, when you succeed with style on a create advantage roll with Drive and place an aspect on an opponent, you may exchange one of your free invocations for a 2-shift hit on that opponent.

*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* On Horseback
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Preferred Mount
compendium.body:
Choose a type of riding animal. +2 to overcome or create advantage with Drive when mounted on that kind of animal.

*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* On Horseback
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Ride Anything
compendium.body:
If it can be ridden like a riding beast, you can ride it. You suffer no increased difficulty for a lack of familiarity, no matter how strange the mount.

*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* On Horseback
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.28.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Run Them Down
compendium.body:
+2 to attack with Drive when you try to trample someone with your horse.

*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* On Horseback
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: We Ride as One
compendium.body:
You fight and act on horseback without penalty, and nothing can knock you off. Any time you would take a physical consequence, you can opt for the horse to take it instead — the horse having a similar consequence track to your character.

*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* On Horseback
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.97 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Sailor
compendium.body:
+2 to Drive whenever you use it to operate a water-borne vessel.

*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* On the Water
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Flying Ace
compendium.body:
You are a skilled combat pilot, and as such may roll Drive instead of Shoot to attack in a dogfight.

*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.21.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Gunner
compendium.body:
You’re a former military man with the training to use vehicle-mounted weaponry. You may use your Drive skill to make attacks with such weapons.

*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Mechanic
compendium.body:
You may roll Drive instead of Crafts when working on a wheeled vehicle.

*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.9.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Mounted Combat
compendium.body:
You may roll Drive instead of Fight to make melee attacks whenever you are riding an animal.

*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikia.com/wiki/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Old Salt
compendium.body:
You may use Drive instead of Lore to make predictions about the weather.

*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Plane Mechanic
compendium.body:
You may roll Drive instead of Crafts when working on a vehicle capable of flight.

*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.21.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Traffic Watcher
compendium.body:
You really know how to use those rear-view mirrors. You may use Drive instead of Notice to be aware of vehicles and road conditions, to detect vehicular ambushes, and to determine turn order while operating a vehicle.

*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Flawless Navigation
compendium.body:
The skies (or roads) are an open map in your mind. +2 to Drive when navigating to a strange place or overcoming being Lost.

*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Evil Hat Productions Wiki · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Hard to Shake
compendium.body:
+2 to Drive whenever you’re pursuing another vehicle in a chase scene.

*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate Core, p.107 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: One Hand on the Wheel
compendium.body:
Multitasking behind the wheel is second nature to you. +2 to overcome with Drive after you successfully create an advantage in a contest.

*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Pedal to the Metal
compendium.body:
You can coax more speed out of your vehicle than seems possible. Whenever you’re engaged in any contest where speed is the primary factor (such as a chase or race of some kind) and you tie with your Drive roll, it’s considered a success.

*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate Core, p.107 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Ramming Speed!
compendium.body:
When ramming another vehicle, you ignore two shifts of damage. So if you ram and hit for four shifts, you only take two yourself.

*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate Core, p.107 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Signature Ride
compendium.body:
You’ve used a certain vehicle so much that its operation is instinctive to you. Pick a specific make and model of vehicle. Add two to your Drive skill when using that sort of vehicle.

*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Steady Driver
compendium.body:
Once per scene, you may reroll a failed Drive roll for free.

*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Turn on a Dime
compendium.body:
Somehow, no matter how crazy you drive, you always seem to pull it off. +2 to Drive when making very tight turns and trying to fit through very narrow spaces.

*Requires:* Defensive Driving
*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.9.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Unsafe at Any Speed
compendium.body:
You are the bane of curbside markets and rickety struts holding up awnings. When you hit an object other than a character or vehicle, increase the stress you cause by 2. Any time an object is taken out by the damage, the result should be spectacular – an explosion or collapse.

*Skill:* Drive · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.9.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Architecture of the Heart
compendium.body:
