Reading a room is a triviality to you. Even more, you can spot the emotional lynchpins in a room and easily understand how actions would impact the mood. If you roll Empathy to read a room—difficulty Mediocre (+0)—count how many shifts you accrue. Over the course of the scene, you may ask the GM to tell you how people would react to any hypothetical scenario. You can do this a number of times equal to the number of shifts generated.

*Skill:* Empathy · *Group:* Insight
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.99 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: The Artist's Eye
compendium.body:
When you encounter a work of art, you may use Empathy to read the artist's emotional state, as if you had had interpersonal contact with them. You may also create advantages with Empathy related to the authenticity of the work.

*Skill:* Empathy · *Group:* Insight
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.4.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Cold Read
compendium.body:
Once per scene, you may use Empathy to read a person's emotional state without the need for interpersonal contact.

*Skill:* Empathy · *Group:* Insight
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.10.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Heart's Secret
compendium.body:
When you successfully use Empathy to read a person's emotional state, if that person's aspects are secret, the aspects the GM reveals must be those that are of the utmost importance to the person, unless you explicitly instruct her otherwise. If the person's aspects are not secret, you may choose which one to attach each of your free invocations to.

*Skill:* Empathy · *Group:* Insight
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century, §6.10.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: A Peek Inside
compendium.body:
You achieve such a strong understanding of your subject that you can start to make some fairly accurate guesses about his behavior. After you have successfully read a person's emotional state, you may immediately ask the GM a hypothetical question about that person’s motives, which the GM must be able to answer with "yes", "no", or "maybe", to the best of her ability. The question must speak to the kind of person the target is, not things they’ve done, though it may ask if they are capable of doing such things. If the GM answers with a "maybe", you may ask a second question to get clarification. This second question may seek details, rather than another one-word answer.

*Requires:* at least two other Empathy stunts
*Skill:* Empathy · *Group:* Insight
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century, §6.10.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Read You Like a Book
compendium.body:
People's emotions are pretty damn obvious to you. +2 to create advantages with Empathy when using it to read a person's emotional state.

*Skill:* Empathy · *Group:* Insight
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: The Truth of Who You Are
compendium.body:
Every two minutes of conversation you have with someone reveals one of their aspects. However, for every two aspects you learn, you reveal one of your own to that person and anyone listening. Round down, so the first one you learn is free.

*Skill:* Empathy · *Group:* Insight
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.98 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: You've Got Issues
compendium.body:
+2 to create advantage with Empathy on a character's trouble aspect.

*Skill:* Empathy · *Group:* Insight
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: I’ve Heard Every Lie in the Book
compendium.body:
+2 to overcome or defend against lies with Empathy.

*Skill:* Empathy · *Group:* Lie Detection
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: The Inner Eye Sees Inner Truth
compendium.body:
Without rolling, you can tell if another character is lying so long as the target’s Deceive is equal to or lower than your Empathy. In the case of high Deceive, you will know that you cannot tell, but will never receive a “false positive.”

*Skill:* Empathy · *Group:* Lie Detection
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.99 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Lie Whisperer
compendium.body:
+2 to all Empathy rolls made to discern or discover lies, whether they’re directed at you or someone else.

*Skill:* Empathy · *Group:* Lie Detection
*Source:* Fate Core, p.109 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Truth Beyond the Lie
compendium.body:
Once per scene, when you successfully see through a lie, you may gain a free invocation on whichever of the liar’s aspects is most closely associated with their reason for lying to you.

*Skill:* Empathy · *Group:* Lie Detection
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Animal Empathy
compendium.body:
You can use Empathy in place of Lore to sense the emotions of animals.

*Skill:* Empathy · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Hit Them Where It Hurts/Disturbingly Insightful
compendium.body:
Your skill at reading people makes you adept at provoking a strong emotional response if you’re trying to get them angry, depressed, or something similar. You may use Empathy in place of Provoke to make mental attacks.

*Skill:* Empathy · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century, §6.10.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Nose for Trouble
compendium.body:
You can use Empathy instead of Notice to determine your turn order in a physical conflict, provided you’ve gotten a chance to observe or speak to those involved for at least a few minutes beforehand during this scene.

*Skill:* Empathy · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Fate Core, p.109 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: One Breath
compendium.body:
A true samurai can size up a foe within a single breath. You may use Empathy to read when a person will attack you and evaluate their combat skills.

*Skill:* Empathy · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Track the Soul
compendium.body:
Your understanding of people you’ve met is sufficiently strong that it gives you an easy sense of how to find them. You may roll Empathy instead of Investigate whenever you’re tracking down or otherwise trying to find someone you’ve met before.

*Skill:* Empathy · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.10.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Bartender's Ear
compendium.body:
Like any good bartender, you know how to understand drunk people. Add two to your Empathy skill when dealing with people who are under the influence of alcohol.

*Skill:* Empathy · *Group:* Other
*Source:* http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Ebb and Flow
compendium.body:
You are so aware of the social currents in a situation that you are able to see something of what’s coming before it arrives. At the beginning of any exchange, you may spend a fate point to attempt to create an advantage with Empathy. You may then act normally on your turn as usual.

*Skill:* Empathy · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.10.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Listening Ear
compendium.body:
+2 to overcome or create advantage with Empathy when you listen to another person for half an hour or more.

*Skill:* Empathy · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Preemptive Grace
compendium.body:
You are so tuned into social situations that you may act quickly and decisively to shape the situation to your liking. +2 to Empathy for the purposes of determining turn order in a conflict.

*Requires:* Ebb and Flow
*Skill:* Empathy · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.10.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Psychologist
compendium.body:
Once per session you can reduce someone else’s consequence by one level of severity (severe to moderate, moderate to mild, mild to nothing at all) by succeeding on an Empathy roll with a difficulty of Fair (+2) for a mild consequence, Good (+3) for moderate, or Great (+4) for severe. You need to talk with the person you’re treating for at least half an hour in order for them to receive the benefits of this stunt, and you can’t use it on yourself. (Normally, this roll would only start the recovery process, instead of changing the consequence level.)

*Skill:* Empathy · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate Core, p.109 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Army of One/The King Still Stands
compendium.body:
You are a one-man army; the odds don’t matter to you. Whenever you are physically attacked by a mob, opponents in that mob do not get a teamwork bonus to their attacks.

*Requires:* Brawler
*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Against Multiple Opponents
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.13.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Army on the Edge of My Blade
compendium.body:
You take no penalty—and grant no bonus—for being outnumbered, no matter how preposterous the numbers.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Against Multiple Opponents
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.97 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Brawler
compendium.body:
You’re at home in any big old burly brawl, with multiple opponents and ideally some beer in you. When fighting a mob of nameless NPCs, you deal one additional stress on a successful physical hit.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Against Multiple Opponents
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.13.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Follow-Through
compendium.body:
Once per conflict, when you inflict a physical consequence on an opponent with Fight, you may also inflict a 2-point physical hit on another opponent in the same zone.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Against Multiple Opponents
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Whirlwind Attack
compendium.body:
You may make a Fight attack against every opponent in your zone, dividing your roll between them as you see fit.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Against Multiple Opponents
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Advanced Warmaster
compendium.body:
When you’re fighting anyone who is armed with a sword, you get a further +2 bonus to creating an advantage using Warmaster.

*Requires:* Warmaster
*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Against Specific Opponents
*Source:* Fate Core, p.94 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Destroyer of Abominations
compendium.body:
You hit harder when your enemy is something blasphemous. You gain +2 to attacks with Fight against creatures that are unusually offensive to your faith.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Against Specific Opponents
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Favored Enemy
compendium.body:
Choose an organisation or ethnic group. You gain +2 on attacks made with Fight against a member of that group. (Exercise discretion in the use of this stunt. A racist villain is probably OK, but a racist PC is almost certainly not.)

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Against Specific Opponents
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Favored Enemy Parry
compendium.body:
Choose an organisation. You gain +2 to defend with Fight against members of that group.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Against Specific Opponents
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Mirror Stance
compendium.body:
Your unusual fighting style lets you defend effortlessly when you and your opponent are similarly armed. +2 to defend with Fight whenever your opponent attacks you with the same kind of weapon as you wield.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Against Specific Opponents
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Reflection Shatters the Mirror
compendium.body:
You can switch in a heartbeat from matching your opponent move for move to doing precisely the opposite. +2 to attack with Fight whenever your opponent wields the same kind of weapon as you do. (adapted from http://dfrpg-* Unorthodox Fighting. People with formal training are less able to defend against your tomfoolery in combat. +2 to attacks with Fight against opponents who strictly adhere to a formal style of combat.

*Requires:* Mirror Stance
*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Against Specific Opponents
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Riposte
compendium.body:
If you succeed with style on a Fight defense, you can choose to inflict a 2-shift hit rather than take a boost.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Counterattacks
*Source:* Fate Core, p.91 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Turnabout
compendium.body:
When you succeed with style on a Fight defense, instead of taking a boost, you may spend a fate point to inflict physical stress equal to the shifts you got on your defense roll. You may only do this once per opponent per scene.

*Requires:* Riposte
*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Counterattacks
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.29.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Ally’s Shield
compendium.body:
You can invoke Dwarven Shield-Maiden when a nearby ally suffers an attack. When you do, redirect that attack to yourself. Your defense is Average (+1) against that attack.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Defending Others
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.34 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Defend the Weak
compendium.body:
When someone is attacked physically while within your zone, you can spend a fate point to redirect that attack to yourself. You may defend against that attack at +1.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Defending Others
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.41 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Leave My Friends Alone!
compendium.body:
+2 to attack with Fight when your opponent’s most recent action was to attack one of your allies.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Defending Others
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Close at Hand
compendium.body:
You can bring your weapon to hand faster than the eye can track. If the difficulty of overcoming an aspect of Disarmed or similar is Fair (+2) or less, you may overcome it as a free action. If the difficulty is higher, instead gain +2 on the roll to overcome that aspect.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Disarming
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.15.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Disarming Specialist
compendium.body:
You have been trained in how to disarm an armed combatant. Once per scene per opponent, when you successfully defend against an attack with a melee weapon, you may sacrifice your next action to place the Disarmed aspect on that opponent.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Disarming
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikia.com/wiki/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Firm Grip
compendium.body:
+2 to defend with Fight against being disarmed.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Disarming
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Fists of Fury
compendium.body:
Swinging wildly and with force, you can strike at an opponent over and over again, wearing down his defense with each blow. +2 to Fight whenever you punch an opponent who is using full defense.

*Requires:* Brawler
*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Full Defense
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.13.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Flawless Parry/Perfect Parry
compendium.body:
+2 to defend with Fight when you perform a full defense action.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Full Defense
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.29.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Guard Breaker
compendium.body:
When you attack someone who is performing a full defense action, you gain +2 to Fight.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Full Defense
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Blind-Fight
compendium.body:
Your ability to attack with Fight works unimpeded by conditions like darkness or other visual impairments.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* In Specific Environments
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Master of the Roof
compendium.body:
+2 to defend with Fight when you are at a higher elevation than your opponent.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* In Specific Environments
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Mountain Warrior
compendium.body:
+2 to defend with Fight when your opponent is at a higher elevation than you.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts)
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Precise Swing
compendium.body:
You suffer no increased difficulty on Fight rolls from aspects related to cover.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts)
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Tunnel Fighter
compendium.body:
Your Fight skill works unimpeded by conditions such as narrow passages, low ceilings, or other spatial limitations.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts)
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Ride-By Attack
compendium.body:
Once per scene, you may move one zone while mounted, attack with Fight, and then move one additional zone, provided there are no situation aspects restricting movement.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Mounted Combat
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Unhorse
compendium.body:
+2 to create advantage with Fight when you try to remove someone from their mount’s back.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Mounted Combat
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Bull Charge
compendium.body:
You know how to use your momentum in a fight. +2 to attack with Fight whenever you move at least one zone unopposed before you attack with a fist or other blunt weapon.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Special Moves
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.13.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Dispatch the Fallen
compendium.body:
Once per scene, when you attack an enemy who is Prone, Knocked to the Ground, or similar, you gain +2 to attack with Fight.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Special Moves
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Flying Kick
compendium.body:
You are able to leap through the air, leading with a powerful kick that can lay an unsuspecting opponent out. +2 to attack with Fight whenever you move at least one zone unopposed before you attack with a kick.

*Requires:* Martial Arts
*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Special Moves
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.13.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Killing Stroke
compendium.body:
Once per scene, when you force an opponent to take a consequence, you can spend a fate point to increase the consequence’s severity (so mild becomes moderate, moderate becomes severe). If your opponent was already going to take a severe consequence, he must either take a severe consequence and a second consequence or be taken out.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Special Moves
*Source:* Fate Core, p.111 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Knockback
compendium.body:
When you succeed with style on an attack with Fight, you may choose to reduce the value of your hit by one in order to move your opponent one zone, provided there are no situation aspects impeding this movement.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Special Moves
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Signature Strike
compendium.body:
You have a specific attack which you have honed to devastating perfection. Describe it as an aspect (for instance Thousand Whirlwinds Strike As One! or Kick in the Crotch). Once per conflict, as a free action, you can attach this aspect to an opponent as a boost.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Special Moves
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.13.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Spring Attack
compendium.body:
Once per scene, you may move one zone on foot, attack with Fight, and then move one additional zone, provided there are no situation aspects restricting movement.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Special Moves
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Stunning Fist
compendium.body:
Once per physical conflict, when you succeed on an unarmed attack, you may place the aspect Stunned on your opponent with one free invocation.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Special Moves
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Do You Like It?
compendium.body:
I Made It Myself. A weapon you made yourself is a weapon that you know really well. +2 to defend with Fight when opponents attempt to disarm you or turn the limitations of your weapon against you.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* With Specific Weapons
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: My Blade Strikes True
compendium.body:
Once per conflict, you can force the opponent to use a mild consequence instead of a 2-point stress box on a successful Fight attack with your heirloom sword.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* With Specific Weapons
*Source:* Fate Core, p.93 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Two Sword Joe
compendium.body:
Normally, fighting with two swords just looks cool, but when you wield two swords, you have a decisive advantage. Any time you succeed on an attack with two swords, the stress inflicted is increased by one.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* With Specific Weapons
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.15.4 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Anything Goes
compendium.body:
Virtually anything can be a lethal weapon in your hands, as long as you can comfortably and casually lift it. You never need to spend a fate point in order to declare that an improvised weapon is close at hand, unless your surroundings have been deliberately prepared against this (such as a prison cell).

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* With Any Weapon
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.29.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Weapons of the World
compendium.body:
Every kind of proper (not improvised) hand-held melee weapon in the world has been in your hands at one point or another. Once per conflict, when you handle an unusual weapon of this type, you may tell a quick two- or three-sentence story (either to another character or as an internal monologue) to gain a +2 on your next roll with it.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* With Any Weapon
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.29.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Bloodlust
compendium.body:
Once per scene, when you inflict a physical consequence, you gain one additional invocation of that consequence.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Demoralising Stance/My Weapon Speaks For Me/Talking With My Fists
compendium.body:
As a trained fighter, you are able to adopt a stance that makes it unequivocally clear how capable you are of handing someone his ass. Whenever displaying your fighting stance or threatening someone with violence, you may roll Fight instead of Provoke to scare them.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.13.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Hidden Weapons
compendium.body:
Your knowledge of weapons helps you conceal them. You may use Fight instead of Burglary to conceal weaponry.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Mixed Martial Artist
compendium.body:
You practice judo or another grappling-based martial art. You may use Fight instead of Physique to create advantages related to wrestling and pinning.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Parry Everything
compendium.body:
Your hand-eye coordination is superb, and perhaps you could even deflect a bullet with your weapon. You may use Fight to defend against Shoot attacks. (The GM may limit this stunt by having it only apply to slower projectiles or those fired from another zone.)

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikia.com/wiki/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Whip Grip
compendium.body:
You can use Fight to grab things with a whip.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Armiger
compendium.body:
Whenever you take a mild physical consequence, you can choose to instead destroy your armor or your shield, provided you’re using the appropriate item. Once your armor or shield is destroyed, you’ll have to get it repaired or get a new one.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.41 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Backup Weapon
compendium.body:
Whenever someone’s about to hit you with a Disarmed situation aspect or something similar, spend a fate point to declare you have a backup weapon. Instead of a situation aspect, your opponent gets a boost, representing the momentary distraction you suffer having to switch.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate Core, p.111 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Dirty Fighter
compendium.body:
You have a talent for fighting dirty and are experienced in pulling all manner of tricks in order to get the upper hand on your opponents. Any time you invoke an opponent’s aspect in a physical fight, you get an additional +1 on the roll.

*Requires:* Brawler
*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.13.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Competition Fighting
compendium.body:
You excel on the mat or in the ring. +2 to attack with Fight as long as the combat is part of an adjudicated sport and is not a matter of life and death.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Cut Off
compendium.body:
When someone defends against your Fight roll, and they succeed with style, they do not receive a boost.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.3.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: The Drunkard Swings Wide
compendium.body:
Your blows are crude and telegraphed, but in dodging, your opponent seems to be struck by an elbow or a knee by accident. Make your Fight roll as normal. If you strike your opponent, you do stress as normal. If you miss or tie, your opponent takes one physical stress anyway.

*Requires:* Drunken Shove from Physique
*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.150 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Ground and Pound
compendium.body:
When you successfully attack someone with Fight whom you are grappling, you inflict 2 additional stress.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Heavy Hitter
compendium.body:
When you succeed with style on a Fight attack and choose to reduce the result by one to gain a boost, you gain a full situation aspect with a free invocation instead.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate Core, p.111 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Hold the Line
compendium.body:
When you share a zone with an ally who also has this stunt, you gain +2 to defend with Fight.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Kick the Bruise
compendium.body:
It really hurts to take two hits to the same place. Once per conflict, when you invoke a physical consequence on a successful Fight attack, you can spend a fate point to increase that consequence's severity (so mild becomes moderate, moderate becomes severe) before your opponent takes stress from your successful attack. If you invoked a severe consequence, your opponent must either take a consequence from your attack or be taken out.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Martial Arts
compendium.body:
You have an acute insight into the means and methods of barehanded warfare. +2 to create advantages with Fight when you assess another martial artist's style.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.13.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Brickbreaker/Board Breaking
compendium.body:
You are able to focus the force of your blows into a concentrated, small area that is devastating to solid materials. You may make attacks with your body against objects that would typically only be damaged by weapons or tools. If you attack something softer, such as wood, any stress you deal is doubled.

*Requires:* Martial Arts
*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.13.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Fist of Death
compendium.body:
By concentrating your force into a powerful blow, you may devastate even the most potent of opponents. Once per opponent per fight, you may spend a fate point after landing a successful blow to cause your opponent to check their highest unchecked physical stress box (instead of taking stress equal to the shifts you succeeded by).

*Requires:* Martial Arts
*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.13.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Martial Scholar
compendium.body:
Once you know your opponent, besting them is easy. When you successfully create an advantage with Fight based on assessing an opponent's combat style, you gain an extra free invocation.

*Requires:* Martial Arts
*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Right Back At You
compendium.body:
Once per scene, when you succeed with style on a Fight defence against a Shoot attack, you may send the projectile flying back towards your attacker, inflicting a 2-shift physical hit on them.

*Requires:* Parry Everything
*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Spears of Green Wood
compendium.body:
You may train a body of troops—unnamed characters in a group of up to approximately 100—for a week and increase their Fight Skill by +1. You can repeat this multiple times, improving any given unit to a maximum of your Fight -2.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.97 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Steady the Drunkard
compendium.body:
You stagger and seem about to fall, so you reach out and grab your opponent’s arm to steady yourself. This seemingly unintentional grip blocks chi and paralyzes your opponent. You may place a Chi Blocked situation aspect with a free invocation on your opponent. Your opponent may not use any kung fu stunts until they remove this aspect.

*Requires:* The Drunkard Swings Wide
*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.150 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Use Their Strength Against Them
compendium.body:
Excessive strength can be a disadvantage if your opponent knows how to exploit it. +2 to Fight rolls made to defend against an opponent, provided the opponent is physically much stronger than you.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikia.com/wiki/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Warmaster
compendium.body:
+2 to Fight rolls made to create an advantage against an opponent, provided the opponent has a fighting style or weakness you can exploit.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate Core, p.299 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Weapon Finesse
compendium.body:
+2 to create advantages with Fight related to fancy but harmless bladework, such as cutting your insignia into your opponent’s clothing.

*Skill:* Fight · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Eavesdropper
compendium.body:
On a successful Investigate roll to create an advantage by eavesdropping on a conversation, you can discover or create one additional aspect (though this doesn’t give you an extra free invocation).

*Skill:* Investigate · *Group:* Senses
*Source:* Fate Core, p.113 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Eye for Detail
compendium.body:
Your visual memory is so strong that with a little concentration, you can revisit any place you've been to in your memory in exacting detail. Sometimes, you can even pick up on details that you hadn’t consciously realized before. To use this ability, spend a fate point and make a single perception-based roll (usually Investigate, but not necessarily limited to that) to find things out as if you were still in the location, no matter how long ago you left it.

*Requires:* Scene of the Crime
*Skill:* Investigate · *Group:* Senses
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.17.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Focused Senses
compendium.body:
You are skilled at concentrating on one of your senses to the exclusion of all others. The sense must be specified at the time this stunt is taken. As a free action, you may gain the Focused on My Senses aspect. So long as this aspect remains, for as long as you use nothing but Investigate, all Investigate actions you take that use the specified sense gain a +2 bonus. However, your opponents may invoke the aspect against you once for free. Rolling a skill other than Investigate removes the aspect. (This stunt may be taken multiple times, each time for a single sense. If you have specified multiple senses, your focus may cover all of them at once.)

*Skill:* Investigate · *Group:* Senses
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.17.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Impossible Detail
compendium.body:
When paying attention, your senses operate at a profound level of focus, allowing you to pick up on details that, very simply, no one else easily or even possibly could. With this stunt, you face no increased difficulties due to a physical detail being too small or subtle.

*Requires:* Focused Senses
*Skill:* Investigate · *Group:* Senses
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.17.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Scene of the Crime
compendium.body:
You have a strong visual memory, and whenever you revisit a place where you have used Investigate before, it takes a matter of seconds for you to use Investigate to determine what has changed since you were last there.

*Skill:* Investigate · *Group:* Senses
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.17.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: De-Bugger
compendium.body:
+2 to overcome with Investigate when you sweep a room for surveillance devices.

*Skill:* Investigate · *Group:* Specific Targets
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Game Hunter’s Nose
compendium.body:
Choose a type of animal. You gain +2 to create advantage or overcome with Investigate when you search for or track that kind of animal.

*Skill:* Investigate · *Group:* Specific Targets
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Hit the Books
compendium.body:
+2 to overcome or create advantage with Investigate when you seek or consult textual sources.

*Skill:* Investigate · *Group:* Specific Targets
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Internal Affairs
compendium.body:
+2 to overcome or create advantage with Investigate when on the trail of corruption.

*Skill:* Investigate · *Group:* Specific Targets
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Plague Hunter
compendium.body:
+2 to Investigate when you seek people with a highly infectious disease.

*Skill:* Investigate · *Group:* Specific Targets
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Relic Hunter
compendium.body:
+2 to Investigate when you seek artefacts from ancient civilizations.

*Skill:* Investigate · *Group:* Specific Targets
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Tracker
compendium.body:
+2 to Investigate rolls made to analyse or follow a person or creature's physical trail.

*Skill:* Investigate · *Group:* Specific Targets
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: The Pieces of the Puzzle
compendium.body:
When you take a few minutes to study a particular item and its position, you can reasonably reconstruct the chain of events that led to it being there. This reconstruction will be accurate, though it will not reveal any more than the necessary details. For example, it might reveal that it was carried by hand at some point, but not by whom.

*Skill:* Investigate · *Group:* Deduction
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.93 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: The Power of Deduction
compendium.body:
Once per scene you can spend a fate point (and a few minutes of observation) to make a special Investigate roll representing your potent deductive faculties. For each shift you make on this roll you discover or create an aspect, on either the scene or the target of your observations, though you may only invoke one of them for free.

*Skill:* Investigate · *Group:* Deduction
*Source:* Fate Core, p.113 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Uncanny Hunch
compendium.body:
Sometimes your guesses play out to great advantage. Once per scene, you may make a guess about what the “deal” is with a particular character, object, location, or situation. Do not speak this guess aloud; write it down on a piece of paper and give it to the GM. The GM must accept it as a valid hunch that would be something of a revelation if true (i.e., no “I’m convinced that moon orbits the Earth!” – that’s too obvious). If, at some later point, your hunch proves to be correct, you may use your Investigate or Empathy skill instead of any other skill, where that target is concerned, for one exchange. (A savvy GM will occasionally alter her characters’ motives to match your hunches; if she does, that’s absolutely perfect!)

*Requires:* one other Investigate stunt and one Empathy stunt
*Skill:* Investigate · *Group:* Deduction
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.17.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Attention to Detail
compendium.body:
You can use Investigate instead of Empathy to defend against Deceive attempts. What others discover through gut reactions and intuition, you learn through careful observation of microexpressions.

*Skill:* Investigate · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Fate Core, p.113 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Going Undercover
compendium.body:
Sometimes looking like someone else is just part of a detective's job. You may use Investigate in place of Deceive to create and maintain disguises or cover identities.

*Skill:* Investigate · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: I Will Find Out What I Want To Know
compendium.body:
There's not much point being able to get information from a crime scene if you can't get information from a person. You may use Investigate in place of Provoke to interrogate a suspect.

*Skill:* Investigate · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Evil Hat Productions Wiki · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Investigative Reporter
compendium.body:
Your writing style depends more upon good research than anything else. You may use Investigate instead of Provoke or Rapport for journalism.

*Skill:* Investigate · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Lip Reader
compendium.body:
You may use Investigate to eavesdrop on conversations you can only see. If the GM would normally allow someone to attempt to read lips, you gain +2 to the roll; otherwise, you may simply roll Investigate when others may not.

*Skill:* Investigate · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.17.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Look Behind You
compendium.body:
Following a suspect is easy; doing it without their knowledge is the trick, and you've got that trick down. You may use Investigate in place of Stealth when shadowing a "person of interest".

*Skill:* Investigate · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Reading Suspects
compendium.body:
Part of being a good detective is knowing "whodunit" long before anything can be proved. You may use Investigate in place of Empathy when you have at least one piece of evidence indicating that your target is a suspect in your current case.

*Skill:* Investigate · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: They Don't Deserve the Truth
compendium.body:
You may use Investigate in place of Deceive to lie to about a case.

*Skill:* Investigate · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Quick Eye
compendium.body:
You are able to investigate a location much more quickly than others, while still being very thorough. All Investigate efforts you make happen one to two time increments faster than usual, allowing you to make one or two additional rolls in the same amount of time, or simply conclude your investigation faster than you would otherwise.

*Skill:* Investigate · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.17.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Animal Affinity
compendium.body:
Pick a particular type of animal (cats, rodents, horses or the like). At the start of any scene, if that type of animal could reasonably appear in the location where the scene is set, you may make a Lore check against a difficulty of Fair (+2). If you succeed, there is an animal of this type in the scene.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Beasts
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Animal Friend
compendium.body:
Pick a particular type of animal (cats, rodents, horses or the like). You can communicate with animals of this type using a combination of speech and gestures. This doesn’t connote a special level of intelligence on the part of the animals, so the communication may be relatively simple. You also gain +2 to your rolls when interacting socially with animals of this type.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Beasts
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.28.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Kindred Beast
compendium.body:
Choose a type of animal. You gain a further +2 to create advantage or overcome when you try to calm or communicate with animals of that kind.

*Requires:* Wild Empathy
*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Beasts
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: King of the Beasts
compendium.body:
This stunt functions as Animal Friend does, but the character may speak to an entire broad category of animals, rather than just one type. For purposes of this ability there are three main categories – creatures from or from near the sea (fish, whales, seabirds), creatures from the land (dogs, primates, cats, birds) and vermin (bugs, rats and other small scuttling things). There is loose overlap between these categories – pigeons are in all three – and the GM is encouraged to be generous in her interpretation.

*Requires:* Animal Friend
*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Beasts
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.28.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Wild Empathy
compendium.body:
+2 to create advantage or overcome with Lore when you try to calm or communicate with animals.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Beasts
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: The Blessing of a Thousand Tongues
compendium.body:
You may learn any language quickly. With tutelage, it takes only a day. With only the opportunity to read or listen, it takes a week. If the source material is especially sparse, it may take as long as a month.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Languages
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.94 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Gift of Tongues
compendium.body:
. There is no “mainstream” earthly language you cannot read or speak. Not only that, but you read and speak languages you have no business having learned, such as languages from lost cultures. You may spend a fate point to declare that you know any particular language, no matter how strange.

*Requires:* Linguist
*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Languages
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.2.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Linguist
compendium.body:
You know a wide range of languages. +2 to Lore whenever reading, writing, speaking or translating an unusual language.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Languages
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.2.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Shared Humanity
compendium.body:
Once per scene, you can communicate a short message to another human even if you do not speak a common language.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Languages
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Photographic Memory
compendium.body:
+2 to Lore rolls whenever you lack direct access to research materials and the answer you seek lies in something you have read before.

*Requires:* Walking Library
*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Memory
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.2.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Studied Recall
compendium.body:
Your photographic memory extends outside of books. Once per scene, you may spend a fate point and roll Lore against a difficulty of Mediocre. Each shift you generate may be used to specify a target that you wish to memorize as you might a book – returning later, in your mind, to assess new details (using an appropriate perception skill, usually Investigate). (This ability differs from Investigate’s Eye for Detail stunt in that Eye for Detail covers the entire location, after the fact, whereas Studied Recall requires you to specify which individual pieces of a location you are studying, while you are still in that location.)

*Requires:* Photographic Memory
*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Memory
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.2.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Walking Library
compendium.body:
Your prodigious reading has paid off in spades, and you are able to recall minute details from even the most obscure literary works. You don’t ever have to spend a fate point to declare that you have the proper tools for research using Lore, even in extreme situations (like being imprisoned and unable to access a library). This source of opposition is just off the table.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Memory
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.2.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Drinking from the Jug
compendium.body:
You pause to take a swig of wine from your jug, fortifying yourself for the battle. When you have a drink during a fight, clear your lowest stress box. This requires you to take an entire action drinking.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Medicine
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.150 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Forensic Medicine
compendium.body:
You can use Lore in place of Investigate when the subject involves medical evidence.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Medicine
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.25.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Heal Thyself
compendium.body:
+2 to treat your own physical consequences with Lore.

*Requires:* Scholar, Healer
*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Medicine
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Herbal Remedies
compendium.body:
+2 to Lore rolls related to gathering plants suitable for treating the sick or injured.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Medicine
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Plastic Surgeon
compendium.body:
You know how to rearrange someone's face permanently. When you operate on a patient, you may use Lore to inflict physical stress on them. The greater the change you wish to make, the graver the consequence you must successfully inflict. (The GM decides what level of consequence is required for each change, and the consequence acts as justification for the patient to change an aspect to one relating to physical appearance at the next milestone. To alter an aspect against a character's will requires you to inflict an extreme consequence.)

*Requires:* Scholar, Healer
*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Medicine
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Pouring Wine
compendium.body:
You take out a cup and pour a drink from your jug. This elaborate and difficult task causes a pause in the battle. No one may attack you while you pour, and you remove your lowest stress mark. This technique requires an entire action, and you may not perform the technique more than once in a row.

*Requires:* Drinking from the Jug
*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Medicine
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.150 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Scholar, Healer
compendium.body:
Can make physical recovery attempts with Lore.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Medicine
*Source:* Fate Core, p.300 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Surgeon/Medical Specialist
compendium.body:
You are a respected authority in a specific field of surgical or therapeutic medicine; define it at the time you take this stunt. Possibilities include heart or brain surgery, transplant operations, disease pathologies, and so on. You get a +2 to all Lore rolls relating to that field.

*Requires:* Scholar, Healer
*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Medicine
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.25.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Dizzying Intellect
compendium.body:
Your area of knowledge is so advanced, there’s usually no one around who can tell if you’re making things up. You may use Lore in place of Deceive to tell lies related to your field of specialization.

*Requires:* Specialist
*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Scholarship
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.2.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: It's Academic
compendium.body:
Once per scene you can spend a fate point (and a few minutes of observation) to make a special Lore roll representing a flash of insight. For each shift you make on this roll you discover or create an aspect related to your field of specialization, on either the scene or the target of your observations, though you may only invoke one of them for free.

*Requires:* Specialist
*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Scholarship
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.2.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Secrets of the Stacks
compendium.body:
Pick a specific library or other large information resource. You are intimately familiar with this resource's quirks, and gain a +2 to Lore whenever you have sufficient time to consult it.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Scholarship
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Specialist
compendium.body:
Choose a field of specialization, such as herbology, criminology, or zoology. You get a +2 to all Lore rolls relating to that field of specialization.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Scholarship
*Source:* Fate Core, p.115 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Tutor
compendium.body:
+2 to create advantage on an ally with Lore when you spend an hour or so coaching them on an appropriate topic.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Scholarship
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Caveman Lifestyle
compendium.body:
You know how to live naked in the wilderness. When you undertake survival activities, you never suffer increased difficulty due to a lack of tools.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Survival
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Due North
compendium.body:
You always know which direction north is, flawlessly, even underground, without a compass or stars to guide you. You gain a +2 to Lore rolls whenever trying to find your way out of a place.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Survival
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.28.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Forager
compendium.body:
Choose a natural habitat (e.g. forests, grasslands, deserts, oceans, or caves). You gain +2 to Lore when gathering food in that habitat.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Survival
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Natural Dowser
compendium.body:
+2 to create advantage with Lore when you seek sources of water.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Survival
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Pathfinder
compendium.body:
Navigating on foot with your Lore skill works impeded by poor visibility or difficult terrain.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Survival
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Scout the Path
compendium.body:
+2 to create advantage with Lore when blazing a trail through the wilderness.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Survival
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Self-Sufficient
compendium.body:
You don’t ever have to spend a fate point to declare that you are able to find enough food and water for yourself, even in extreme situations (like being dumped in the middle of the desert and separated from all your stuff). This source of opposition is just off the table.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Survival
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Advanced Ritualist
compendium.body:
You gain a +2 bonus when you use Lore in place of another skill during a challenge. This allows you to use Lore twice in the same challenge.

*Requires:* Ritualist
*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Fate Core, p.94 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Actions Speak Louder Than Words
compendium.body:
Dealing with animals, who don't talk, has given you an excellent grasp of body language. You may use your Lore skill instead of Empathy to defend against attempts to attack or create advantage with Deceive.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Animal Magnetism
compendium.body:
It's a bit demeaning to equate seduction to animal training, but in your experience there isn't all that much difference between the two activities. You may use Lore instead of Provoke to seduce people.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Cracker
compendium.body:
You may use Lore in place of Burglary to defeat computerised security.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Formal Logic/Master of Riddles
compendium.body:
Your intelligence lets you run circles around those you talk to. This may take the form of actual riddles, or perhaps just complex logical arguments. You may use Lore to make attacks that inflict mental stress and to create advantages related to confusing and overaweing people. Such actions can be defended against with Rapport, Lore, or Empathy.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Frontiersmen Have To Improvise
compendium.body:
Making stuff out of the things around you is an integral part of wilderness survival. You may use Lore in place of Crafts to build things out of scavenged materials.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Outdoorsman
compendium.body:
Your extensive field experience helps you operate in the wild. You may roll Lore instead of Stealth whenever you are in the wilderness, and may also roll Lore instead of Investigate for tracking in those areas.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Pre-Prepared Counterpoint
compendium.body:
You’ve heard that argument before, and you know how to defeat it. You may use Lore to defend against Rapport.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Professional Teacher
compendium.body:
You may use Lore in place of Rapport to interact with your students.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Ritualist
compendium.body:
Use Lore in place of another skill during a challenge, allowing you to use Lore twice in the same challenge.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Fate Core, p.91 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Shield of Reason
compendium.body:
You can use Lore as a defense against Provoke attempts, provided you can justify your ability to overcome your fear through rational thought and reason.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Fate Core, p.115 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Theory in Practice
compendium.body:
Once per scene you can spend a fate point to use Lore in place of any other skill for one roll.

*Requires:* Specialist
*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.25.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: They're In the Trees
compendium.body:
Basic wilderness survival includes a great deal of stealth. You may use Lore in place of Stealth as long as you are outdoors.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Well-Travelled
compendium.body:
You may use Lore instead of Rapport when you have visited the homeland or home state of the person you are speaking to.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Arcane Expert
compendium.body:
Gain a +2 bonus to create an advantage using Lore, whenever the situation has specifically to do with the supernatural or occult.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate Core, p.90 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Bletchley's Finest
compendium.body:
+2 to overcome with Lore when cracking a code.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Dealer in Antiquities
compendium.body:
+2 to create advantages with Lore based on the monetary value of archaeological finds.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Experimenter
compendium.body:
While others are content to read the journals, you have the training and drive to perform cutting-edge research. +2 to Lore whenever you run original scientific experiments or gather original research data.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikia.com/wiki/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: The Eye Sees All Paths
compendium.body:
You may not know everything, but you always know how to find out. When looking for a fairly specific piece of information, you may give the GM a fate point to be told the closest place you can go to find out, no matter how obscure or lost the information is. In short, you can never hit a wall when trying to find something out. There are no guarantees of how easy it will be to get the knowledge, but that’s what adventure is for.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.93 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: I’ve Read about That!
compendium.body:
You’ve read hundreds—if not thousands—of books on a wide variety of topics. You can spend a fate point to use Lore in place of any other skill for one roll or exchange, provided you can justify having read about the action you’re attempting.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate Core, p.115 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Keeper of Folklore
compendium.body:
+2 to Lore when recalling the history or legends of your people.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Legal Eagle
compendium.body:
+2 to overcome or create an advantage with Lore, whenever you are finding or exploiting loopholes in the law.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.18.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Meteorologist
compendium.body:
You are trained as a meteorologist and so you are skilled at weather prediction. +2 to Lore when creating advantages to do with the weather.

*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: World Court
compendium.body:
Your exposure to international law is so extensive that you’re at ease in any situation involving legal wrangling, wherever you are. You never suffer any increased difficulty from a lack of familiarity with the laws of your locale; your experience is so broad that you’ve either know it already, or can make highly educated guesses about how it functions.

*Requires:* Legal Eagle
*Skill:* Lore · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.18.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: On Top Of It
compendium.body:
You may spend a fate point to go first in an exchange, regardless of your Notice. If multiple people with this stunt exercise this ability, they go in turn based on their skills, before those who don’t exercise the stunt get a chance to act. If the exchange has already started, and you have not yet acted, you may instead spend a fate point to act next, out of the usual turn order.

*Skill:* Notice · *Group:* Reflexes
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.3.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Ready for Anything
compendium.body:
Your senses are so keyed into minute changes that you are able to respond more quickly to new details. Your Notice is considered to be one higher for purposes of determining turn order. This stunt breaks ties whenever facing opponents with the same Notice. This stunt may be taken multiple times, each time increasing the character’s effective Notice by 1.

*Requires:* On Top Of It
*Skill:* Notice · *Group:* Reflexes
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.3.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Run Interference
compendium.body:
Whenever it is determined that you provide active opposition to another character's action, you may spend a fate point. When you do, the other character may choose to attempt another action instead. If they do not, you receive +2 on your defend roll against the original action.

*Requires:* Ready for Anything
*Skill:* Notice · *Group:* Reflexes
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.3.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Constant Vigilance
compendium.body:
When you are ambushed, gain a further +2 to the first defend roll you make.

*Requires:* Saw It Coming
*Skill:* Notice · *Group:* Vigilance
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.3.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Danger Sense
compendium.body:
You have an almost preternatural capacity for detecting danger. Your Notice skill works unimpeded by conditions like total concealment, darkness, or other sensory impairments in situations where someone or something intends to harm you.

*Skill:* Notice · *Group:* Vigilance
*Source:* Fate Core, p.117 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Saw It Coming
compendium.body:
When you are ambushed, gain +2 to any defend rolls you make in the first exchange.

*Requires:* Danger Sense
*Skill:* Notice · *Group:* Vigilance
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.3.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: The Eye Gazes in All Directions
compendium.body:
You are never surprised. Even if it’s only by a moment, you are always forewarned of the unexpected.

*Skill:* Notice · *Group:* Vigilance
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.93 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Sentry
compendium.body:
You have the ability to wait, devoting your full effort to watchfulness, for hours on end. +2 to defend with Notice whenever you are tired.

*Skill:* Notice · *Group:* Vigilance
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Take It All In
compendium.body:
Once per scene you can spend a fate point (and a few minutes of observation) to make a special Notice roll representing opening your senses to a location. For each shift you make on this roll you discover or create an aspect related to direct observation on the scene, though you may only invoke one of them for free.

*Skill:* Notice · *Group:* Vigilance
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.3.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Body Language Reader
compendium.body:
You can use Notice in place of Empathy to learn the aspects of a target through observation.

*Skill:* Notice · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Fate Core, p.117 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Master of the Tell
compendium.body:
Long practice has made you incomparably good at noticing the mannerisms that accompany deception. +2 to Notice when using it to defend against Deceive.

*Requires:* Notice Tell
*Skill:* Notice · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Notice Tell
compendium.body:
Your keen senses allow you to pick up on the subtle clues that indicate when a person is lying. You may use Notice to defend against Deceive.

*Skill:* Notice · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Reactive Shot
compendium.body:
You can use Notice instead of Shoot to make quick, reactive shots that don’t involve a lot of aiming. However, because you’re having a knee-jerk reaction, you’re not allowed to concretely identify your target before using this stunt. So, for example, you might be able to shoot at someone you see moving in the bushes with this stunt, but you won’t be able to tell if it’s friend or foe before you pull the trigger. Choose carefully!

*Skill:* Notice · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Fate Core, p.117 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: The Advantage of Familiarity
compendium.body:
There are benefits to knowing a place really well. Pick a location or a small neighbourhood. +2 to Notice while you are in that area.

*Skill:* Notice · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Attention!
compendium.body:
You have been trained to follow orders instantly in combat. When determining turn order for a physical conflict, you may use an ally's Notice skill instead of your own.

*Skill:* Notice · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Game Hunter’s Eye
compendium.body:
Choose a type of animal. You gain +2 to create advantage or overcome with Notice to spot that kind of animal.

*Skill:* Notice · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Heightened Awareness
compendium.body:
+2 to defend with Notice during a physical conflict.

*Skill:* Notice · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Hidey-Holes
compendium.body:
+2 to create advantage with Notice based on finding a suitable location to stay hidden.

*Skill:* Notice · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Keen Sense
compendium.body:
Choose a physical sense (e.g. sight, hearing, touch, taste, smell). You gain +2 to defend or overcome with Notice when that sense is the primary one being used.

*Skill:* Notice · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Recognise Imposter
compendium.body:
+2 to overcome with Notice when faced someone claiming to be a celebrity or someone you know well.

*Skill:* Notice · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Always Healthy/Strong Immune System
compendium.body:
+2 to overcome rolls with Physique to resist disease.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Endurance
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Death Defiance
compendium.body:
If you are taken out in a physical conflict, you may spend a fate point to concede instead. After you have collected fate points for conceding, you must spend a further amount of half of your fate points, rounded down. Coincidence conspires to keep you alive, and you pass from the view of the other combatants (such as by dropping off a cliff, apparently failing to escape from an exploding building, or the like). You may re-enter play in any subsequent scene in as dramatic a fashion as you see fit, explaining to everyone how you survived. You return with all of your physical stress cleared and a single additional consequence incurred to reflect the dangers you defied.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Endurance
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.11.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Desertborn
compendium.body:
+2 to overcome or defend with Physique against heat and thirst.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Endurance
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Developed Immunities
compendium.body:
You gain a further +2 to overcome rolls with Physique to resist any poison you have previously encountered "on screen".

*Requires:* Toxin Exposure
*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Endurance
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.11.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Large Lung Capacity
compendium.body:
+2 to Physique to overcome or defend against suffocation or drowning.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Endurance
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Last Leg
compendium.body:
You may spend fate points to keep standing. Any time you would suffer a consequence or be taken out by physical stress, you may spend a fate point to remain standing or otherwise defer a consequence for one more exchange, or until you take stress again, whichever comes first. Once the extra time you've bought is up, all the effects you have deferred come to bear at once. You may keep spending fate points each time the time limit expires until you run out. (This makes it possible for you to be taken out by a character who has already conceded or been taken out in the intervening time!)

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Endurance
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.11.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Tireless
compendium.body:
+2 to Physique when rolling to overcome or defend against exhaustion or sleep deprivation.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Endurance
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.11.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Toxin Exposure
compendium.body:
+2 to overcome rolls with Physique to resist poisons.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Endurance
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.11.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Body Toss
compendium.body:
You know how to apply your strength in a fight to take people off their feet. +2 to create advantages with Physique whenever you try to throw or push someone.

*Requires:* Wrestler
*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Pushing and Shoving
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.19.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Domino Effect
compendium.body:
When you succeed with style on an attempt to push over or trip an opponent, you may create an additional identical aspect on another weaker opponent in the same zone. Both aspects come with one free invocation. (“Weaker opponent” here means an opponent with a lower Physique than the one who defended against your action.)

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Pushing and Shoving
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: The Drunken Shove
compendium.body:
Your rude and artless push contains a greater power than seems possible. You gain +2 to use Physique to create an advantage on an opponent by knocking them off balance.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Pushing and Shoving
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.150 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Low Centre of Gravity
compendium.body:
+2 to defend with Physique against attempts to trip or grapple you.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Pushing and Shoving
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Scrum
compendium.body:
You may roll Physique to push yourself and an opponent into an adjacent zone, provided there are no situation aspects impeding movement. Your opponent may defend with either Athletics or Physique.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Pushing and Shoving
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Face the Pain
compendium.body:
You are able to lessen the effects of physical injury thanks to your incredible stamina. Once per scene, you may spend a fate point, and uncheck any one of your physical stress boxes.

*Requires:* Feel the Burn
*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Stress and Consequences
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.11.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Feel the Burn
compendium.body:
You can push through incredible pain in order to reach your goal. You gain an additional mild consequence slot. This slot can only be used for physical harm.
