*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Stress and Consequences
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.11.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Man of Iron
compendium.body:
When you take physical stress, and the stress box with a value equal to the shift value of the hit is already checked, you may instead mark the next lowest value box that is unchecked. Very simply, this means that you don’t start picking up consequences unless someone hits you for more than your highest value box (difficult at best!) or all of your boxes are filled up.

*Requires:* Thick Skinned
*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Stress and Consequences
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.11.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: One Hit to the Body
compendium.body:
When you take physical stress, you may check off two stress boxes with a total value equal to or greater than the shift value of the hit.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Stress and Consequences
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.11.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Thick Skinned
compendium.body:
You gain one more physical stress box.

*Requires:* One Hit to the Body
*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Stress and Consequences
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.11.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Tough as Nails
compendium.body:
Once per session, at the cost of a fate point, you can reduce the severity of a moderate consequence that’s physical in nature to a mild consequence (if your mild consequence slot is free), or erase a mild consequence altogether.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Stress and Consequences
*Source:* Fate Core, p.119 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Grappler
compendium.body:
+2 to Physique rolls made to create advantages on an enemy by wrestling or grappling with them.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Wrestling
*Source:* Fate Core, p.119 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Hammerlock
compendium.body:
Whenever you have hold of someone and they fail to overcome your hold, you deal 1 shift of physical stress to them.

*Requires:* Wrestler
*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Wrestling
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.19.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Unbound/Clever Wrestling
compendium.body:
You aren't easy to hold down. +2 to overcome with Physique whenever you are physically restrained in some fashion - for example by chains or a mob of people.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Wrestling
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.19.1, and http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Bounce Back
compendium.body:
You may roll Physique instead of Lore when performing a physical recovery action on yourself.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.11.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Fling Foe
compendium.body:
You may roll Physique to throw an enemy you have Picked Up into an adjacent zone. You must overcome any situation aspects that impede the enemy’s movement.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Heavy Object Swing
compendium.body:
Sometimes pure strength can compensate pretty well for a lack of skill. You may use Physique instead of Fight whenever you use a heavy object as a melee weapon.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikia.com/wiki/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Heavy Object Throw
compendium.body:
If you spin a weight fast enough, it can become airborne. You may use Physique instead of Shoot to attack targets one zone away with a heavy object.

*Requires:* Heavy Object Swing
*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikia.com/wiki/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Mighty Pull
compendium.body:
You can use Physique to create advantages related to your ability to draw bows back further than most, granting extra force to the arrow or bolt.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Muscle Your Way Up
compendium.body:
Climbing is basically like weightlifting, except you are the weight. You may use Physique in place of Athletics when climbing.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Piledriver
compendium.body:
You may make attacks against inanimate targets using Physique instead of Fight.

*Requires:* Herculean Strength
*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.19.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Shield Sling
compendium.body:
When armed with a shield, you may attack an opponent one zone away with Physique, but doing so places the aspect No Shield on you.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Take the Blow
compendium.body:
You can use Physique to defend against Fight attacks made with fists or blunt instruments, though you always take 1 shift of stress on a tie.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Fate Core, p.119 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Toughness of Mind and Body
compendium.body:
A guy as tough as you has no need to be afraid. You may use Physique instead of Will to defend against fear.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Unstoppable
compendium.body:
Once in motion, you are very difficult to stop due to your sheer muscular force. You may use Physique rather than Athletics to move between zones.

*Requires:* Herculean Strength and at least one other Physique stunt
*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.19.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Wrestler/Power Over Finesse
compendium.body:
Your unarmed attacks rely on brute strength rather than on technique. You may make such attacks against other humans with Physique rather than Fight.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.19.2, and http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Bend Bars, Lift Gates
compendium.body:
You may spend a fate point to automatically overcome a Physique obstacle, even if you’ve already rolled for it, provided you’re trying to accomplish something through brute strength.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.41 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Charge Like Ox
compendium.body:
Because you are Strong Like Ox, once per scene, as a single action, you may move two zones in a straight line then make a physical attack.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.34 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Favored Enemy Tackle
compendium.body:
Choose an organisation. You gain +2 to create advantage with Physique against members of that group.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Give As Good As I Get
compendium.body:
Sometimes you have to do something crazy in order to win a fight. Once per conflict, when you take physical stress, you may choose to incur an additional physical consequence. In exchange, you may create a situation aspect on your opponent with a number of free invocations: two for a minor consequence, three for a moderate, four for a severe.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Herculean Strength
compendium.body:
+2 to overcome or create advantage rolls with Physique that involve lifting great weights.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.19.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Hulking Rage
compendium.body:
While you have the aspect Enraged on you, you gain +2 to overcome and create advantage with Physique.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: None Shall Pass
compendium.body:
+2 to defend with Physique against attempts to move past you.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Now You've Made Me Mad
compendium.body:
Once per scene, after taking physical stress, you may spend a fate point to add the shift value of the attack (after any reduction by consequences) as a bonus to an action in the next exchange taken against the person who inflicted the stress.

*Requires:* two other Endurance stunts
*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.11.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Smashing Rage
compendium.body:
While you have the aspect Enraged on you, you gain +2 to break inanimate objects with Physique.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Trample
compendium.body:
Once per scene, when you succeed with style on a create advantage roll with Physique and place an aspect on an opponent, you may exchange one of your free invocations for a 2-shift hit on that opponent.

*Skill:* Physique · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Aura of Fear
compendium.body:
Your intimidating appearance and attitude are potent, making you able to intimidate entire crowds. Once per scene, you may spend a fate point and make an intimidation attempt against all opponents in the scene. If you succeed, attach an aspect representing the intimidation to each opponent. (This doesn't get you any additional free invocations of these aspects.)

*Requires:* Aura of Menace
*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* Intimidation
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.16.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Aura of Menace
compendium.body:
You are the terror of all those who oppose you. Once per scene per target, you may spend a fate point to intimidate a target as a free action, no matter what the circumstances, immediately (if between actions), or immediately after the current action underway.

*Requires:* Scary
*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* Intimidation
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.16.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Crown of Menace
compendium.body:
You are too terrifying to be attacked. Until you make a physical attack in a scene, characters with a Will lower than Good (+3) simply cannot attack you. Those with sufficient Will to attack still flinch on their first attack, though, automatically missing.

*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* Intimidation
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.98 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Daunting Presence
compendium.body:
+2 to create advantages similar to Daunted with Provoke.

*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* Intimidation
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Fearsome Gaze
compendium.body:
Your gaze is so terrifying that those faced with it can end up paralyzed with fear. This stunt is used in the same fashion as Steely Gaze, but if your opponent loses to the point of taking a consequence, he takes other consequences immediately afterwards. Even if this means he’s taken out, the target retains the option to concede after recording the consequence.

*Requires:* Steely Gaze
*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* Intimidation
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.16.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Master of Fear
compendium.body:
You are a master of the terrifying, and can have an entire room cowering within moments. Nameless NPCs who are affected by your Aura of Fear are automatically taken out; they simply flee or faint.

*Requires:* Fearsome Gaze and Aura of Fear
*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* Intimidation
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.16.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Menacing Demeanor
compendium.body:
When you are face-to-face with another person, gain +2 to create advantages specifically related to fear on them with Provoke.

*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* Intimidation
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Subtle Menace
compendium.body:
You exude menace far in excess of your capability to act. Even bound and behind prison bars, you are so ripe with the promise of the awful things you could do that you're still scary. +2 to Provoke rolls when opposed by someone in a clearly superior position of power.

*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* Intimidation
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.16.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Berserk Rage
compendium.body:
When you suffer a physical consequence, you can invoke that consequence for free on your next attack. If you suffer multiple physical consequences, you get a free invocation for each.

*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* Rage
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.34 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Infuriate
compendium.body:
Sometimes fear isn’t an option, but that doesn’t mean you can’t still get up someone’s nose. +2 to Provoke rolls whenever deliberately trying to get someone angry with you.

*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* Satire and Mockery
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.16.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Master of Mockery
compendium.body:
When you place an aspect such as Enraged with <Your Name Here> on an opponent, that opponent can do nothing but attack you until the aspect is overcome.

*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* Satire and Mockery
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Poison Words
compendium.body:
Your skill at satire is so profound that you can take a whole audience with you. During a satirical performance, advantages you create with Provoke attach to each character present. You choose to which person your free invocations apply.

*Requires:* Razor Tongue
*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* Satire and Mockery
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.4.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Razor Tongue
compendium.body:
You know how to craft the most exquisite insults. +2 to create advantage with Provoke whenever you eloquently insult a rival.

*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* Satire and Mockery
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.4.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Teflon Troublemaker
compendium.body:
When your Can’t Keep His Big Mouth Shut aspect is compelled to make you the target of an attack, you may immediately clear any mild consequences you currently have, instead of taking a fate point.

*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* Satire and Mockery
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.34 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Ladies' Man/Popular Gal
compendium.body:
You’re adept at catching the eye of the opposite sex, and keeping it once you’ve got it. Any seduction attempts you make with Provoke receive a +2 bonus whenever the target is someone who could be receptive to it (this is not always a simple case of gender and preference).

*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* Seduction
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.22.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Armor of Fear
compendium.body:
You can use Provoke to defend against Fight attacks, but only until the first time you’re dealt stress in a conflict. You can make your opponents hesitate to attack, but when someone shows them that you’re only human your advantage disappears.

*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Fate Core, p.120 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: The Fight in the Dog
compendium.body:
You can use Provoke to enter the kinds of contests that you’d normally need Physique for, whenever your ability to psych your opponent out with the force of your presence alone would be a factor.

*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Fate Core, p.89 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Imposing Attitude
compendium.body:
For some reason, people seem reluctant to disagree with you. Maybe it’s your cologne. You may use Provoke instead of Rapport to defend attempts to damage your reputation.

*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Okay, Fine!
compendium.body:
You can use Provoke in place of Empathy to learn a target’s aspects, by bullying them until they reveal one to you. The target defends against this with Will. (If the GM thinks the aspect is particularly vulnerable to your hostile approach, you get a +2 bonus.)

*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Fate Core, p.120 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Scary
compendium.body:
You are just someone people don’t want to cross, and that’s clear even to other intimidating folks. You may use Provoke instead of Will to defend against Provoke.

*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.16.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: The Serpent's Tongue
compendium.body:
It’s hard not to talk to you. Not because you're approachable, but because it seems like such a bad idea not to. Fear makes people uncomfortable, and they occasionally let things slip they would not otherwise. You may use Provoke in place of Empathy or Rapport when trying to get information out of someone in a “softer” fashion. If successfully used in this way, the target is definitely rattled – so it certainly doesn’t leave the target in the same pleasant state he might be left by one of those other skills. If used to read a character's emotional state, the aspects revealed are limited only to those which might be expressed in the language of fear.

*Requires:* Subtle Menace
*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.16.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Tell Me or Else!
compendium.body:
You don't ask nicely when there's stuff you need to know. You may roll Provoke instead of Contacts when you are gathering information from your informants.

*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Unapproachable
compendium.body:
It’s difficult to try to manipulate someone when you’re constantly reminded of how scary they are. You may use Provoke instead of Will to provide defend against create advantage actions made with Deceive, Empathy, or Rapport.

*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.16.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Bad Cop
compendium.body:
Cruelty is more effective when given a basis for comparison. Once per scene, gain +2 to Provoke when invoking an aspect created by someone who has the Good Cop stunt.

*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Berate the Underlings
compendium.body:
+2 to create advantage or attack with Provoke when you interact with your subordinates.

*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Favored Enemy Rattle
compendium.body:
Choose an organisation. You gain +2 to attack or create advantage with Provoke against members of that group.

*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Not to Be Trifled With
compendium.body:
When you make it clear how dangerous you are, roll Provoke against your target’s Will. If you succeed, that target will not attack you or willingly come near you unless you take action against him first. If you succeed with style, neither will anyone with a lower Will than your target.

*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.35 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Provoke Violence
compendium.body:
When you create an advantage on an opponent using Provoke, you can use your free invocation to become the target of that character’s next relevant action, drawing their attention away from another target.

*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate Core, p.120 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Scare 'Em Straight
compendium.body:
You are an authority figure. Part of your job is to put the fear of the law in potential miscreants. +2 to Provoke when using it to frighten someone under your authority (e.g. students for a teacher).

*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: The Promise of Pain
compendium.body:
Once per conflict, you can force the opponent to use a mild consequence instead of a 2-point stress box on a successful Provoke attack.

*Requires:* Scary
*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.16.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Steely Gaze
compendium.body:
Your unflinching gaze can lock an opponent in place. When you look an opponent in the eyes and successfully create an advantage with Provoke, both of you can only take Provoke actions against each other until one of you takes a consequence, concedes, or is interrupted (by, say, a gunshot).

*Requires:* Scary
*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.16.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Street Talk
compendium.body:
+2 to Provoke when dealing with the inhabitants of slums.

*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Torturer
compendium.body:
You have the complete lack of mercy that is needed to torture someone properly. Once per scene, when you force an opponent to take a consequence instead of mental stress, you can spend a fate point to increase the consequence’s severity (so mild becomes moderate, moderate becomes severe). If your opponent was already going to take a severe consequence, he must either take a severe consequence and a second consequence or be taken out.

*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Wounds From a Friend
compendium.body:
It's hard to disbelieve what those closest to you tell you. While successfully impersonating someone, your successful Provoke attacks on their close associates inflict two additional stress.

*Skill:* Provoke · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Do You Know Who I Am?
compendium.body:
Once per scene, you may identify yourself in order to get your way and add +2 to a Contacts, Deceive, Provoke, or Rapport roll.

*Requires:* Virtuoso
*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* Art
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.4.4 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Moving Performance
compendium.body:
When you create an advantage with Rapport using your art, the difficulty of removing the resulting aspect increases by +2.

*Requires:* Virtuoso
*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* Art
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.4.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Stage Presence
compendium.body:
+2 to overcome distractions with Rapport while performing.

*Requires:* Virtuoso
*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* Art
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.4.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Virtuoso/Artist
compendium.body:
Choose a field of art, such as painting, composition, or singing. You get a +2 to all Rapport rolls relating to that art.

*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* Art
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.4.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Demagogue
compendium.body:
+2 to Rapport when you’re delivering an inspiring speech in front of a crowd. (If there are named NPCs or PCs in the scene, you may target them all simultaneously with one roll rather than dividing up your shifts.)

*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* Oratory
*Source:* Fate Core, p.121 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Excellent Speaker
compendium.body:
Public speaking is an everyday thing to you. +2 to Rapport whenever you make a formal speech to a group.

*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* Oratory
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikia.com/wiki/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Another Round?
compendium.body:
+2 to Rapport when drinking with someone in a tavern.

*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* Specific Audiences
*Source:* Fate Core, p.298 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Blood is Thicker Than Water
compendium.body:
+2 to Rapport when dealing with members of your extended family.

*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* Specific Audiences
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Captain’s Word
compendium.body:
Once per scene, you may roll Rapport to command your crew as a free action.

*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* Specific Audiences
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Child of the Court
compendium.body:
Gain a +2 bonus to any attempt to overcome obstacles with Rapport when you’re at an aristocratic function, such as a royal ball.

*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* Specific Audiences
*Source:* Fate Core, p.90 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Good Cop
compendium.body:
Kindness is more effective when given a basis for comparison. +2 to Rapport when creating advantages to assist someone who has the Bad Cop stunt.

*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* Specific Audiences
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Honest Salesman
compendium.body:
Making a sale comes as naturally to you as breathing. +2 to Rapport when using it to sell goods or services.

*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* Specific Audiences
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikia.com/wiki/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Master of the Mob
compendium.body:
+2 to Rapport when dealing with a crowd or mob.

*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* Specific Audiences
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Negotiator
compendium.body:
+2 to Rapport when you try to broker an end to an armed conflict.

*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* Specific Audiences
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Scion of the Court
compendium.body:
When you overcome an obstacle with Child of the Court, you may additionally create a situation aspect that describes how the general attitude turns in your favor. If anyone wants to try and get rid of this aspect, they must overcome Fair (+2) opposition.

*Requires:* Child of the Court
*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* Specific Audiences
*Source:* Fate Core, p.94 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Target Audience
compendium.body:
Pick a specific field of endeavour, such as crime, business, politics, espionage, or the occult. Gain +2 to Rapport rolls whenever dealing with someone from that field.

*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* Specific Audiences
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.7.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: All the World's a Stage/Playing to Expectations
compendium.body:
Your acting talent is natural and unquestionable. You may roll Rapport instead of Deceive when convincing a target you are someone you aren't.

*Requires:* one other Rapport stunt
*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.4.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Animal Whisperer
compendium.body:
You may use Rapport instead of Lore to issue commands to animals.

*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Blather
compendium.body:
It’s not that you’re a good liar – possibly far from it. It’s more that you have a skill at talking so fast, and not letting the other guy get a word in edgewise, that he doesn’t ever get the chance to figure out if you’re lying or not. You may create an aspect such as Blathering on yourself which justifies active opposition to Alertness rolls in your zone. You cannot take other actions while blathering, but you may spend a fate point to negate any successful roll that overcomes the aspect. The targets of this effort are by no means helpless – if they are attacked or otherwise disturbed they may respond normally, and they will respond to obvious stimuli (friends being attacked in their line of sight, fire alarms going off and such). However, they are definitely distracted. Once you stop talking, it may be time for a quick exit.

*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.22.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Commissions
compendium.body:
Your works and performances are heavily sought out, and there are those who will pay handsomely for it. Once per session, you may use Rapport in place of Resources for one roll, representing a successful past commission.

*Requires:* Virtuoso
*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.4.4 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Large Ham
compendium.body:
You may use Rapport in place of Provoke to intimidate someone.

*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Popular
compendium.body:
If you’re in an area where you’re popular and well-liked, you can use Rapport in place of Contacts. You may be able to establish your popularity by spending a fate point to declare a story detail, or because of prior justification.

*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Fate Core, p.121 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: The Right Questions
compendium.body:
Smaller parts of a larger truth can contain a blueprint of the whole – and as a skilled conversationalist, you are adept at pulling the larger truth out of a single individual. Provided the person you’re talking to is at least neutral towards you, you may use your Rapport skill instead of Contacts for any effort to network. The results are limited and colored by the knowledge available to the person with whom you speak.

*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.22.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Weight of Reputation
compendium.body:
For a fate point, you may use Empathy in place of Contacts, Deceive or Provoke, provided those you are dealing with are aware of your reputation.

*Requires:* Do You Know Who I Am?
*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.4.4 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: All Things in Their Place
compendium.body:
You always know the power dynamic in the room, and you may insert yourself within it anywhere you desire. Use this with caution—while it impacts how people interact with you, it does not equate to actual authority, and placing yourself too highly—especially over people not used to being anything but top dog—can inspire an unpleasant response.

*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.98 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Best Foot Forward
compendium.body:
Twice per session, you may upgrade a boost you receive with Rapport into a full situation aspect with a free invocation.

*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate Core, p.121 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: First Impressions
compendium.body:
Whenever an opponent succeeds with style against the first Rapport roll you make in a scene, they do not gain a boost.

*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.22.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Five Minutes Friends
compendium.body:
For a fate point, you can make a steadfast friend in a place you’ve never been, given a chance for five minutes of conversation. This stunt makes nearly impossible opportunities to make friends merely improbable, improbable opportunities probable, and probable opportunities outright certain.

*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.22.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Heart on My Sleeve
compendium.body:
You’re a regular stand up guy with no secrets, at least so far as anyone can tell. But even so, you’re in control of which part of your best face you’re putting forward. +2 to defend with Rapport against attempts to read your emotional state.

*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.22.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: International
compendium.body:
Your mastery of etiquette leaves you comfortable, and even glib, in any situation. You never suffer any increased difficulty from unfamiliarity with your setting, making it easy to maneuver through local customs you haven’t encountered before, and to cover up any gaffes with a laugh and a sparkle in your eye.

*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.22.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Rustic Charm
compendium.body:
You suffer no increased difficulty on Rapport rolls due to your social class.

*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Smooth Over
compendium.body:
You’re adept at stepping into a bad situation and dialing it down to something more reasonable. So long as you are not the direct reason someone is upset, your attempts to calm them down using your Rapport receive a +2 bonus.

*Skill:* Rapport · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.22.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Grease the Wheels
compendium.body:
You can use Resources instead of Rapport in any situation where bribes will be accepted.

*Skill:* Resources · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.24.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Help Wanted, Reward Offered
compendium.body:
You can use Resources instead of Contacts whenever you make it public exactly what or who you are looking for.

*Skill:* Resources · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.24.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Glitterati
compendium.body:
Money can, in fact, buy friends. You may use Resources in place of Contacts when in high society.

*Skill:* Resources · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Instant Functionary
compendium.body:
You’re skilled at seeing the shape of an organization from the underside, and in organizations of sufficient size, you can easily convince anyone that you’re just another cog in the machine. This allows you to substitute your Resources skill for Deceive whenever pretending to fill the role of a minor functionary of a target organization.

*Skill:* Resources · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.18.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Money Talks
compendium.body:
You can use Resources instead of Rapport in any situation where ostentatious displays of material wealth might aid your cause.

*Skill:* Resources · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Fate Core, p.123 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: My Wallet Has A Lot To Say
compendium.body:
+2 to Resources whenever you use the Money Talks stunt.

*Requires:* Money Talks
*Skill:* Resources · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikia.com/wiki/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: War of Papers
compendium.body:
You can take action against organizations through indirect measures. Effectively you can fight on the level of any organization smaller than a nation without the need to recruit allies or have any organization of your own. Yes, this means you can effectively “kill” a city, or even an army, given enough time.

*Skill:* Resources · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.98 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Best That Money Can Buy
compendium.body:
You have a discerning taste and a natural instinct for spending your money to get exactly the best and nothing less. You are at +2 to your Resources whenever making a purchase of something that would be considered “the best.” While this may seem like a discount, it’s not, really, since seeking out the best may mandate a price mark several steps above the baseline; still, this stunt helps to soften the blow.

*Skill:* Resources · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.24.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Long Term Investment
compendium.body:
You’ve had your money for a while now, and you’ve had a chance to make several strategic investments which you can cash in on when pressed for money. Once per session, you may sell one of these investments to get a +2 to any one Resources roll.

*Skill:* Resources · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.24.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Licenses for Everything
compendium.body:
You suffer no increased penalties on Resources rolls related to legal restrictions on goods.

*Skill:* Resources · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Money Is No Object
compendium.body:
Once per session, when called on to roll Resources, you may spend a fate point and simply act as if you had rolled +4 on the dice. You may do this after the fact on a roll. Your Resources skill will then operate at -2 for the rest of the session; you’ve simply tapped into everything at your disposal to make the purchase.

*Requires:* two other Resources stunts
*Skill:* Resources · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.24.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Rivers of Gold
compendium.body:
Money is just a detail to you. Stripped naked and cast on a desert island, and you’ll be living in luxury in short order. Cast into prison, and you’ll be bribing guards in no time. No situation will restrict your access to your Resources skill.

*Skill:* Resources · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.98 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Savvy Investor
compendium.body:
You get an additional free invoke when you create advantages with Resources, provided that they describe a monetary return on an investment you made in a previous session. (In other words, you can’t retroactively declare that you did it, but if it happened in the course of play, you get higher returns.)

*Skill:* Resources · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate Core, p.123 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Trust Fund Baby
compendium.body:
Twice per session, you may take a boost representing a windfall or influx of cash.

*Skill:* Resources · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate Core, p.123 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Useful Little Things
compendium.body:
Your pockets are full of useful little things. Whenever you need something, you have it, provided it’s not something too unusual (like a map to Jimmy Hoffa’s body) or too large to fit in a pocket, belt pouch, or backpack. When you say you have something, the GM should be likely to agree.

*Skill:* Resources · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.34 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Wholesale Pricing
compendium.body:
Pick a type of business (e.g. supermarket, sporting goods, electronics). You gain +2 to Resources when you attempt to purchase something which that business sells.

*Skill:* Resources · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Scope User
compendium.body:
You know how to use a scope. +2 to create advantages with Shoot related to aiming while using a scope or laser sight.

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* Aiming
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Uncanny Accuracy
compendium.body:
Once per conflict, stack an additional free invoke on an advantage you’ve created to represent the time you take to aim or line up a shot (like In My Sights).

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* Aiming
*Source:* Fate Core, p.125 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Fast Reload
compendium.body:
+2 to Shoot whenever you roll to overcome an aspect of Out of Ammunition or similar that has been placed upon you.

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* Ammunition
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.15.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Lead in the Air
compendium.body:
You really like emptying magazines. Any time you’re using a fully automatic weapon and you succeed at a Shoot attack, you automatically create a Fair (+2) opposition against movement in that zone until your next turn, because of all the lead in the air. (Normally, you’d need to take a separate action to set up this kind of interference, but with the stunt, it’s free.)

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* Ammunition
*Source:* Fate Core, p.90 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: One Shot Left (or Empty Mag, Empty Room)
compendium.body:
That last bullet has a kind of magic to it. Once per scene, you may create an aspect of One Shot Left (equivalently, The Whole Magazine at Once) on yourself as a free action. You may invoke this aspect once for free, but doing so changes the aspect to Out of Ammunition. The Fast Reload stunt explicitly cannot be used to overcome this aspect.

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* Ammunition
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.15.2, and http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Rain of Lead
compendium.body:
+2 to create advantage rolls with Shoot when you create an aspect relating to suppressive fire.

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* Ammunition
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.15.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Crazy Ricochet
compendium.body:
When you use the Ricochet stunt, you may invoke further aspects to represent further bounces, gaining a bonus for each as normal.

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* Indirect Shots
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Fortunate Rebound/Through and Through
compendium.body:
Once per scene, when you succeed with style on a Shoot attack, you may inflict a 2-shift physical hit on another opponent in the same zone instead of gaining a boost.

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* Indirect Shots
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Ricochet
compendium.body:
You may invoke a relevant situation aspect to bounce a projectile off a solid surface, allowing it to come at an opponent from an unexpected direction. (This invocation does not provide its normal bonus.) If your attack is successful, the stress of the hit is increased by 2.

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* Indirect Shots
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.29.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Good Arm
compendium.body:
You have an amazing throwing arm, and can throw weapons with great force. If thrown weapons have a shorter range in your game than guns, this stunt extends that range to two zones, equal to that of guns.

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* Long Range
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.29.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Legendary Archer
compendium.body:
Bows are not just weapons, they're your weapons of choice. When wielding a bow or crossbow, you can make attacks with it from two additional zones away.

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* Long Range
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Long Shot
compendium.body:
You can make physical attacks with Shoot from up to three zones away, rather than the usual two.

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* Long Range
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.15.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Sniper
compendium.body:
Once per scene, you may make an attack with Shoot from up to ten zones away, provided you have a sniper rifle and scope.

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* Long Range
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Feller of Fauna
compendium.body:
To you, guns aren't for killing people; they're for killing animals. +2 to Shoot attacks against mundane animals.

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* Specific Targets
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Game Hunter’s Finger
compendium.body:
Choose a type of animal. You gain +2 to attack with Shoot against that kind of animal.

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* Specific Targets
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Trick Shot
compendium.body:
+2 to create advantage with Shoot when firing at an inanimate object.

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* Specific Targets
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.15.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Gun-Crazy/Way of the Gun
compendium.body:
You may use Shoot instead of Crafts whenever you're working with guns specifically.

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.15.4 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Gun Kata
compendium.body:
You are light on your feet with a gun in your hand, able to keep the gunplay going while evading attempts to harm you. You may use Shoot instead of Athletics to defend against physical attacks.

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.15.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Juggler
compendium.body:
You have a great talent for juggling; this includes the ability to throw around seemingly dangerous objects (knives, torches) without any fear of harm to yourself. +2 to Shoot when using juggling to entertain.

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.26.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Personal Arsenal
compendium.body:
You own a great number of weapons, and you get new ones all the time. Use your Shoot skill instead of your Resources skill when dealing with weaponry.

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Quick on the Draw
compendium.body:
You can use Shoot instead of Notice to determine turn order in any physical conflict where shooting quickly would be useful.

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Fate Core, p.125 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Shot on the Run
compendium.body:
Once per scene, you may move one zone, attack with Shoot, and then move one additional zone, provided there are no situation aspects restricting movement.

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Snap Shot
compendium.body:
Once per conflict, between or before other characters’ actions, you may spend a fate point to preempt the usual turn order and act next. The action taken must involve a roll with your Shoot skill – usually an attack. This may be done in addition to your normal action.

*Requires:* Quick on the Draw
*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.15.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Called Shot
compendium.body:
During a Shoot attack, spend a fate point and declare a specific condition you want to inflict on a target, like Shot in the Hand. If you succeed, you place that as a situation aspect on them in addition to hitting them for stress.

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate Core, p.125 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Master of the Lasso
compendium.body:
+2 to create advantages with Shoot whenever this involves throwing a lasso.

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikia.com/wiki/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Ranged Knockback
compendium.body:
When you succeed with style on a Shoot attack with a thrown weapon, you may choose to reduce the value of your hit by one in order to move your opponent one zone, provided there are no situation aspects impeding this movement.

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Subtle Draw
compendium.body:
+2 to Shoot whenever there is active opposition to your first shot in a scene.

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.15.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Trained As a Unit/Team Player
compendium.body:
You were trained alongside the rest of your unit, and now that unit is like a single organism. +2 to create advantages with Shoot whenever working with another character who is from the same unit as you and who also has this stunt. (A similar stunt could exist in many other skills.)

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Two Gun Joe
compendium.body:
Normally, shooting with two guns just looks cool, but when you fire two weapons, you have a decisive advantage. Any time you succeed on an attack with two guns, the stress inflicted is increased by one.

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.15.4 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Volley
compendium.body:
When you combine Shoot skills with your allies, you contribute an additional +1 bonus.

*Skill:* Shoot · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Face in the Crowd
compendium.body:
+2 to any Stealth roll to blend into a crowd. What a “crowd” means will depend on the environment—a subway station requires more people to be crowded than a small bar.

*Skill:* Stealth · *Group:* In Specific Environments
*Source:* Fate Core, p.126 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Gently Does It
compendium.body:
Your Stealth skill works impeded by inanimate objects that will make sound if disturbed, such as brittle twigs, mouse traps, or wobbly piles of crates.

*Skill:* Stealth · *Group:* In Specific Environments
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Slip Between the Shadows
compendium.body:
+2 to create advantage or overcome with Stealth whenever you are in near-darkness or total darkness.

*Skill:* Stealth · *Group:* In Specific Environments
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Stowaway
compendium.body:
+2 to Stealth when hiding on a ship or other large vehicle.

*Skill:* Stealth · *Group:* In Specific Environments
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Cunning Evasion
compendium.body:
Once per scene, when you successfully defend against an area attack with Athletics, you may roll to create an advantage with Stealth as a free action.

*Skill:* Stealth · *Group:* Sudden Disappearances
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Hidden Sniper
compendium.body:
Once per scene, after you make a Shoot attack, you may roll to create advantage with Stealth as a free action.

*Skill:* Stealth · *Group:* Sudden Disappearances
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Only the Wind Will See Me Go
compendium.body:
At the cost of a fate point, you may exit a scene, passing from sight.

*Skill:* Stealth · *Group:* Sudden Disappearances
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.96 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Quick Exit
compendium.body:
A momentary distraction is all you need to vanish from the scene. Provided you are not in the midst of a conflict, you may roll a quick contest between your Stealth and the highest Notice in the room. If you succeed, the next time someone turns to look at or talk to you, you’re not there.

*Skill:* Stealth · *Group:* Sudden Disappearances
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.27.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Backstab/Sucker Punch
compendium.body:
You can use Stealth to make physical attacks, provided your target isn’t already aware of your presence.

*Skill:* Stealth · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Fate Core, p.89 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Backstab
compendium.body:
When you can surprise an enemy or attack from a place of hiding, you can attack with Stealth. If you succeed, you create a boost. If you succeed with style, you get to invoke that boost for free twice.

*Skill:* Stealth · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.42 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: In Plain Sight
compendium.body:
You can use Stealth to hide even when you're out in the open and wouldn’t normally be able to justify it. However, as soon as you move, you become visible again, unless another stunt you have states otherwise.

*Skill:* Stealth · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.27.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Ninja Vanish
compendium.body:
Once per scene, you can vanish while in plain sight by spending a fate point, using a smoke pellet or other mysterious technique. This places the Vanished boost on you. While you’re vanished, no one can attack or create an advantage on you until after they’ve succeeded at an overcome roll with Notice to suss out where you went (basically meaning they have to give up an exchange to try). This aspect goes away as soon as you invoke it, or someone makes that overcome roll.

*Skill:* Stealth · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Fate Core, p.126 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Shadowed Strike
compendium.body:
After you invoke Vanished on an attack, you may defend with Stealth for the remainder of the current exchange.

*Requires:* Master of Shadows and Ninja Vanish
*Skill:* Stealth · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.27.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Slippery Target
compendium.body:
Provided you’re in darkness or shadow, you can use Stealth to defend against Shoot attacks from enemies that are at least one zone away.

*Skill:* Stealth · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Fate Core, p.126 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Stalker
compendium.body:
You like to watch people who don't know they're being watched. You may use Stealth in place of Investigate to conduct surveillance.

*Skill:* Stealth · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Hush
compendium.body:
Your talent with stealth may be extended to others who are with you close by, provided that you travel as a group. As long as the whole group stays with you and follows your hushed orders, you may make a single Stealth roll for the whole group, using your skill alone. (You cannot apply the benefits of other stunts to this roll.) If someone breaks from the group, they immediately lose the benefits, and may risk revealing the rest of you if they don’t manage to pull off a little Stealth of their own. The maximum number of people that can be with you in the group is equal to your Stealth skill rating.

*Skill:* Stealth · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.27.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Lightfoot
compendium.body:
It’s difficult to track you when you take care to walk lightly. +2 to Stealth when overcoming traps based on weight or pressure.

*Skill:* Stealth · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.27.3 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Master of Shadows
compendium.body:
After you use In Plain Sight, you may move one zone per exchange without becoming visible. If there is an aspect in play that would normally justify the use of Stealth to hide, you may pay a fate point to be able to make an overcome action with Athletics without becoming visible.

*Requires:* In Plain Sight
*Skill:* Stealth · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.27.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Not a Threat
compendium.body:
Choose Deceive or Stealth when you take this stunt. When you create an advantage with that skill to make yourself as non-threatening or unobtrusive as possible, enemies will find other targets for as long as that aspect exists. As soon as you successfully attack someone, the aspect goes away.

*Skill:* Stealth · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.42 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Silent Tank
compendium.body:
For some strange reason, you are capable of sneaking around while wearing 30 pounds of steel plating. You never suffer increased difficulty on Stealth rolls from being armoured.

*Skill:* Stealth · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Fierce Mind
compendium.body:
+2 to overcome fear with Will.

*Skill:* Will · *Group:* Mental Resistance
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Fighting For What You Believe In
compendium.body:
Your faith, in someone or something, is absolute. Pick a being or a concept. +2 to Will when defending that thing or when overcoming separation from it.

*Skill:* Will · *Group:* Mental Resistance
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikia.com/wiki/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Gift of Faith
compendium.body:
+2 to defend with Will against fear and despair.

*Skill:* Will · *Group:* Mental Resistance
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Indomitable/Fearless
compendium.body:
+2 to defend against Provoke attacks specifically related to intimidation and fear.

*Skill:* Will · *Group:* Mental Resistance
*Source:* Fate Core, p.127 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Inner Strength
compendium.body:
+2 to defend with Will against someone trying to get inside your head – be it through psychic means or through extensive torture.

*Skill:* Will · *Group:* Mental Resistance
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.23.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Mind of Steel
compendium.body:
Magical mental influence is useless against your fortress-like mind! +2 to Will when using it to defend against supernatural mental attacks.

*Skill:* Will · *Group:* Mental Resistance
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Set In My Ways
compendium.body:
You're old. It took you decades to form your beliefs and you're not about to abandon them. Add +2 to your Will when using it to resist attempts to change your deeply-held beliefs or your core identity.

*Skill:* Will · *Group:* Mental Resistance
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Stubborn Faith
compendium.body:
You cling to your beliefs with amazing determination. +2 to Will when overcoming or defending against attempts to make you act directly against the principles of your faith.

*Skill:* Will · *Group:* Mental Resistance
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Trust In My Leader
compendium.body:
Pick a person or being who has authority over you and whom you trust. You gain +2 to Will whenever you resist attempts to undermine that trust.

*Skill:* Will · *Group:* Mental Resistance
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Aplomb
compendium.body:
When you go to check off a mental stress box and that box is already checked, you can check off the next lowest value empty box. If there are no unchecked boxes of a lower value, check off a higher value box as normal.

*Requires:* Smooth Recovery
*Skill:* Will · *Group:* Stress and Consequences
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.23.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Cool Customer
compendium.body:
You are so at ease in times of mental stress that nothing seems to dent your calm regard of the situation. During a conflict, you may use your action to roll your Resolve against a target of Mediocre. If you succeed, you may either erase a check in your 1-point mental stress box or spend a fate point to erase a check from any single mental stress box with a value equal to or less than the shifts you gained on your roll.

*Requires:* Smooth Recovery
*Skill:* Will · *Group:* Stress and Consequences
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.23.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Driven
compendium.body:
Whenever you take a moderate or severe consequence from a mental attack, you gain a free invocation on that consequence.

*Requires:* Still Standing
*Skill:* Will · *Group:* Stress and Consequences
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.23.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Hard Boiled
compendium.body:
You can choose to ignore a mild or moderate consequence for the duration of the scene. It can’t be compelled against you or invoked by your enemies. At the end of the scene it comes back worse, though; if it was a mild consequence it becomes a moderate consequence, and if it was already moderate, it becomes severe.

*Skill:* Will · *Group:* Stress and Consequences
*Source:* Fate Core, p.127 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Never Broken
compendium.body:
You gain a -8 physical consequence which recovers in the same way a -2 consequence does.

*Skill:* Will · *Group:* Stress and Consequences
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.95 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Smooth Recovery/Still Standing/Stubborn
compendium.body:
You simply do not know when to quit. You gain an additional mild consequence slot. This slot can only be used for mental harm.

*Requires:* Inner Strength
*Skill:* Will · *Group:* Stress and Consequences
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.23.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Unyielding
compendium.body:
Your force of will is enough to keep you going in the direst of circumstances. Each time you take physical stress, you may spend a fate point to instead take two 1-shift hits of mental stress.

*Requires:* Driven
*Skill:* Will · *Group:* Stress and Consequences
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.23.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Determinate
compendium.body:
Your astonishing determination allows you to push yourself beyond your physical limits. Use Will instead of Physique on any overcome rolls representing feats of endurance.

*Skill:* Will · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: I'll Just Ignore You
compendium.body:
Counterarguments are a waste of time. You prefer to simply not listen to the people you disagree with. You may use Will instead of Rapport to defend against attempts to damage your reputation or make you look bad in front of others.

*Skill:* Will · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Right Place, Right Time
compendium.body:
You seem to always be in a safe spot, without moving in any obvious way. You may use Will to defend against physical attacks, and may also use it to move or take cover (so long as you merely saunter; no sprints allowed). To the outside world, it appears that you are simply staying put and unfazed as gunfire and other attacks miss you by scant inches, or are picking up your undisturbed martini as the werewolf rushes past. Circumstance conspires to leave you undisturbed so long as your defense is not beaten.

*Requires:* Indomitable
*Skill:* Will · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.23.1 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Strength From Determination
compendium.body:
Use Will instead of Physique on any overcome rolls representing feats of strength.

*Skill:* Will · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* Fate Core, p.127 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Sunday School
compendium.body:
Your steadfastness comes from your religious upbringing. You may roll Will instead of Lore whenever seeking or recalling religious knowledge.

*Skill:* Will · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Unbroken Composure
compendium.body:
Your mental strength allows you to remain calm when others would be caught off guard. You may use Will in place of Notice whenever someone is attempting to surprise you.

*Skill:* Will · *Group:* New Actions
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Extraordinary Concentration
compendium.body:
Once per scene, when you successfully create an advantage with Will based on concentration, you gain one additional free invocation.

*Skill:* Will · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Iron Determination
compendium.body:
You may, when you bluntly speak your true intentions in a social interaction, immediately gain a +1 bonus on all subsequent Provoke or Will rolls in that scene. However, if you do this, you may no longer use Rapport with the same audience, as you have peeled away the façade of civility.

*Skill:* Will · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from Spirit of the Century SRD, §6.23.2 · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: Laser-Like Focus
compendium.body:
You find it easy to clear your mind in a stressful situation. +2 to create an advantage with Will related to concentration, willpower, or clear thought.

*Skill:* Will · *Group:* Other
*Source:* adapted from http://dfrpg-resources.wikispaces.com/Stunts · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)

compendium.name: The Mind Is the Greatest Mountain
compendium.body:
So far as social skills are concerned, you do not exist. You cannot be swayed, befriended, intimidated, or otherwise moved. Your speech reveals nothing about you or the veracity of your words. (If another character has the stunt The Inner Eye Sees Inner Truth, for the purposes of that stunt, your Deceive score is higher than their Empathy.)

*Skill:* Will · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Fate System Toolkit, p.95 · *License:* CC-BY-3.0 (Evil Hat Productions)

compendium.name: Parrot
compendium.body:
You can perfectly repeat anything you’ve heard in the last hour or so, even if you don’t know the language it was spoken in. (Normally a Will roll would be required to recall the words correctly.)

*Skill:* Will · *Group:* Other
*Source:* Peter Blake · *License:* CC-BY-SA-2.5 (Evil Hat Productions Wiki)
